title: RIFT-Bench: Dynamic Red-teaming For Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into autonomous decision-making systems, exposing attack vectors beyond those of traditional LLM vulnerabilities. Existing security evaluations are often tied to specific implementations or domains, limiting unified comparison across heterogeneous systems. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT-Bench, a graph representation-driven methodology for dynamic red-teaming that enables unified evaluations across diverse agentic architectures. Building on a novel hierarchical representation, RIFT-Bench operates in two automated phases: Discovery, which extracts system structure, and Scanning, which deploys adaptive adversarial attacks and produces a comprehensive evaluation report. It evaluates the examined system itself, leveraging a broad set of dynamically adaptable adversarial probes across diverse attack vectors and objectives. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation pipeline across 45 agentic systems spanning a diverse range of implementations, showing that the approach generalizes effectively to heterogeneous agentic architectures. Beyond systems and attacks, RIFT-Bench also supports direct evaluation of mitigation strategies. These key capabilities make RIFT-Bench a scalable foundation for security evaluation of agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: RIFT-Bench是一种基于图表示驱动的动态红队测试方法，用于对异构智能体AI系统进行统一安全评估，通过自动化的发现和扫描阶段，实现对45种不同系统的泛化测试。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估方法通常局限于特定实现或领域，缺乏对不同异构智能体系统的统一比较框架。
AI.method: 提出基于图表示的分层架构，包含两个自动化阶段：Discovery（提取系统结构）和Scanning（部署自适应对抗攻击并生成评估报告）。
AI.result: 在45种不同的智能体系统上验证了方法的有效性，证明该方法能够泛化到异构的智能体架构。
AI.conclusion: RIFT-Bench不仅支持系统评估和攻击测试，还能直接评估缓解策略，为智能体AI系统的安全评估提供可扩展的基础框架。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Drive: Rule-Grounded Faithful Reasoning for Driving VLAs
summary: Driving VLA models incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are attractive because they leverage pretrained VLM representations and expose intermediate decisions in natural language, yet current rationales often lack the step-by-step decision semantics needed to keep the rationale causally connected to the planned motion. We introduce Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a neuro-symbolic driving framework that supervises a driving VLA with rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted directly from classical rule-based planners. Our key observation is that rule-based planners are symbolic AI systems that already function as executable reasoning engines: they reason about active safety constraints, search over candidate maneuvers, and select a final trajectory. We instrument these planners in simulation to capture both the executed trajectory and the internal decision trace at each rule-evaluation step. Each trace is serialized into structured rule-grounded reasoning and paired with the trajectory to fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B as a driving VLA. Because these traces are derived directly from the planner states that determine the action, they ensure reasoning is structurally coupled to motion generation by construction, rather than by post-hoc alignment. On our simulator-generated benchmark, detailed rule-grounded reasoning reduces ADE@3s from 0.47 to 0.26 and miss rate from 8.30% to 6.40% under three-camera perception, and from 0.54 to 0.26 and 10.13% to 5.99% under eight-camera perception. Neuro-Symbolic Drive thus converts neuro-symbolic planning logic into structured supervision. Code base: https://github.com/XiangboGaoBarry/Neural-Symbolic-Drive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neuro-Symbolic Drive框架，通过将经典规则规划器中的结构化推理轨迹提取为自然语言推理链，监督VLA驾驶模型。该方法在模拟器基准上将ADE@3s从0.47降至0.26，miss rate从8.30%降至6.40%，实现了规则推理与运动生成的因果耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA驾驶模型虽然引入了Chain-of-Thought推理，但推理链缺乏逐步决策语义，与规划动作之间缺乏因果联系，导致推理与运动生成脱节。
AI.method: 利用经典规则规划器作为可执行的符号推理引擎，在模拟中捕获其内部决策轨迹（包括安全约束评估、候选动作搜索和最终轨迹选择），将每一步规则评估状态序列化为结构化推理链，与对应轨迹配对后微调Qwen3.5-4B作为驾驶VLA。
AI.result: 在三摄像头感知下，ADE@3s从0.47降至0.26，miss rate从8.30%降至6.40%；在八摄像头感知下，ADE@3s从0.54降至0.26，miss rate从10.13%降至5.99%。
AI.conclusion: Neuro-Symbolic Drive通过将神经符号规划逻辑转化为结构化监督信号，有效提升了VLA驾驶模型在推理与运动之间的因果耦合性能，验证了规则规划器生成的推理痕迹作为训练信号的有效性。

title: Critique of Agent Model
summary: What is an agent? What constitutes agency? With the rise of Large Language Model (LLM) systems marketed as ``coding agents'', ``AI co-scientists'', and other ``agentic" tools that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time, ``existential" concerns such as AI escaping human control with destructive power under a speculative ``machine agency" against humans, it has become essential to clarify where automation ends and agency begins, both for building capable systems and for understanding whether and what to fear. Drawing on Descartes' grounding of agency in independent thought, and on portrayals of autonomous beings in science fiction, we survey the current landscape of AI agents, and analyze agent architectures along five dimensions: goal, identity, decision-making, self-regulation, and learning. Specifically, we argue that genuine agency requires these structures to be \emph{internalized within the system itself} rather than assembled through external scaffolding. This distinction between \emph{agentic} systems, whose competence resides in engineered workflows, and \emph{agentive} systems, whose capabilities (including social interaction) arise endogenously, defines the boundary between systems designed for prescribed tasks, and those capable of operating in the open world with true autonomy. Building on this analysis, we propose the Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC) architecture for a general-purpose agent model, combining hierarchical goal decomposition, identity evolution, simulative reasoning grounded in a separately trained world model, learned self-regulation, and self-directed learning from both real and simulated experience. Furthermore, we share insight on the auditability, controllability, and safety of agentive systems that possess greater autonomy and ``agency", but remain under human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了“代理性”（agentic）系统（通过外部工程化流程完成任务）和“能动性”（agentive）系统（具备内生能力，包括真正的自主性），并提出了Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC)通用代理架构，同时讨论了高自主AI系统的可审计性、可控性与安全性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM系统被标榜为“编码代理”“AI共同科学家”等“代理型”工具，同时出现AI失控等存在性担忧，有必要厘清自动化与自主代理之间的界限，以指导系统构建和风险评估。
AI.method: 基于笛卡尔关于自主思考的哲学基础及科幻作品中自主存在的描绘，沿目标、身份、决策、自我调节和学习五个维度分析当前AI代理架构，并据此提出GIC架构。
AI.result: 提出区分“agentic”（代理性）与“agentive”（能动性）系统的核心标准在于决策结构是否内化于系统自身；GIC架构整合了层级目标分解、身份演化、基于独立世界模型的模拟推理、自我调节学习及自我导向学习。
AI.conclusion: 真正的能动性要求系统内化目标、身份、决策等结构；GIC架构为构建兼具高自主性与人类可控性的通用代理模型提供了可行路径。

title: Safe and Generalizable Hierarchical Multi-Agent RL via Constraint Manifold Control
summary: Multi-agent systems are widely used in safety-critical applications that require coordinated behavior under strict safety constraints. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: learning-based methods achieve strong empirical performance but lack theoretical safety guarantees, while control-theoretic methods enforce safety but often lead to overly conservative and inefficient behaviors. We propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enforces hard safety constraints under mild assumptions at low level via a constraint manifold, while enabling effective coordination through high-level policy learning. Our approach provides theoretical safety guarantees in the multi-agent setting and yields stationary learning dynamics, thereby enabling stable and efficient training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive performance while maintaining nearly perfect safety rates, and generalizes effectively to varying numbers of agents and obstacles.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种分层多智能体强化学习框架，通过低层约束流形强制执行硬安全约束，高层策略学习实现有效协调，在保证理论安全性的同时实现高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在安全关键的多智能体系统中存在根本性权衡：基于学习的方法性能好但缺乏安全理论保证，而控制理论方法能保证安全但过于保守低效。
AI.method: 提出分层多智能体强化学习框架：低层通过约束流形强制执行硬安全约束（在温和假设下），高层通过策略学习实现智能体间的有效协调。
AI.result: 方法在多智能体环境下提供理论安全保证，产生平稳学习动力学（稳定高效训练），实验达到接近完美的安全率且性能有竞争力，能有效泛化到不同数量的智能体和障碍物。
AI.conclusion: 该分层框架成功融合了学习方法的性能优势和控制方法的安全保障，打破了安全与效率之间的传统权衡。

title: EXPO-SQL: Execution-based Clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL enables users to query databases using natural language by generating executable SQL queries. Recent methods have increasingly adopted Large Language Models based reinforcement learning (RL) to leverage execution feedback for training. However, existing RL methods assign uniform query-level rewards to all clauses in a SQL query, treating correct and incorrect clauses equally. This coarse-grained reward design leads to insufficient learning signals for correct SQL generation. To address this issue, we propose EXPO-SQL (EXecution-based clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL) which provides fine-grained supervision through clause-level rewards. To assign clause-level rewards, our method identifies erroneous clauses by analyzing execution results, including error messages and clause-wise incremental execution. Experiments on widely-used Text-to-SQL benchmarks demonstrate that EXPO-SQL significantly outperforms existing supervised fine-tuning, prompting, and RL-based methods through fine-grained clause-level learning. Our code is available at https://github. com/jhn25/EXPO-SQL.

AI.tldr: EXPO-SQL提出了一种基于子句级奖励的强化学习方法，用于Text-to-SQL任务，通过细粒度执行反馈（包括错误信息和增量执行）识别错误子句并提供差异化学习信号，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的Text-to-SQL方法对所有子句分配统一的查询级奖励，无法区分正确与错误的子句，导致学习信号不足，限制了SQL生成的准确性。
AI.method: 提出EXPO-SQL框架，通过分析执行结果（错误消息和子句级增量执行）识别错误的SQL子句，为每个子句分配细粒度的奖励信号，从而进行子句级策略优化。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的Text-to-SQL基准测试上，EXPO-SQL显著优于现有的监督微调、提示工程和基于强化学习的方法。
AI.conclusion: 子句级的细粒度奖励设计能够有效解决统一奖励带来的学习信号不足问题，为Text-to-SQL任务提供更准确的SQL生成能力。

title: ModTGCN: Modularity-aware Graph Neural Networks for Text Classification
summary: Graph-based text classification models typically rely on local neighborhood aggregation and overlook global community structure, despite semantic document graphs exhibiting strong class-consistent clustering. Ignoring this can blur class boundaries and lead to over-smoothing. We propose ModTGCN, a modularity-aware graph neural network for text classification that jointly optimizes cross-entropy and a modularity-based auxiliary objective to promote class-coherent document communities while preserving discriminative representations. The modularity term is computed on a document-document similarity graph derived from transformer embeddings (pretrained or fine-tuned). To improve scalability, we decouple the original heterogeneous TextGCN graph into separate document-word and word-word components, achieving 2x-10x faster training. We further study graph construction strategies, label-aware edge reweighting, and supervision choices for modularity optimization. Experiments on five benchmarks show consistent gains, with larger improvements on complex, low homophily datasets such as Ohsumed and 20NG.

AI.tldr: 提出ModTGCN，一种结合模块度感知的图神经网络，通过联合优化交叉熵和模块度辅助目标，在文本分类中促进类别一致的文档社区结构，同时提升训练效率2-10倍。
AI.motivation: 传统基于图的文本分类模型过度依赖局部邻域聚合，忽略了全局社区结构，导致类别边界模糊和过平滑问题。
AI.method: 在TextGCN基础上引入模块度辅助目标函数，使用Transformer嵌入构建文档相似度图，并将异构图解耦为文档-词和词-词两部分以提升效率。
AI.result: 在5个基准数据集上取得一致提升，在复杂低同质性数据集（Ohsumed、20NG）上改进更显著，训练速度提升2-10倍。
AI.conclusion: 模块度感知的图神经网络能有效利用文档图的社区结构，在提升分类性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。

title: Sol Video Inference Engine: Agent-Native Full-Stack Acceleration Framework for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Modern video diffusion models achieve higher generation quality through scaling, but this also increases inference cost. Although many acceleration methods have been proposed, a central challenge is that the most effective acceleration strategy is highly instance-specific: a recipe that works well for one combination of model, hardware, and inference configuration often does not transfer to another. Different models vary in architecture, numerical sensitivity, and attention concentration patterns. Inference settings differ in spatial and temporal resolution and video duration, while hardware platforms differ in memory hierarchy, supported numerical formats, and kernel throughput. These factors create a large tuning space, making manual performance engineering costly. We present Sol Video Inference Engine, an agentic, native, training-free acceleration framework for video diffusion models. It organizes five broadly applicable techniques, cache, sparse attention, token pruning, quantization, and kernel fusion, into an agentic acceleration stack for instance-specific optimization. For a concrete deployment target defined by a model, hardware platform, and serving configuration, parallel skill agents optimize the implementation of each technique, an agent integrator composes them into a global acceleration stack, and a human validator provides feedback on generation quality. We instantiate this workflow on three video models with different sizes and architectures: 64B Cosmos3-Super, 22B LTX-2.3, and 2B SANA-Video. With little human effort, the full stack achieves more than 2x end-to-end acceleration while maintaining near-lossless VBench quality, demonstrating the effectiveness of the agent framework for video diffusion acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sol Video Inference Engine，一个基于智能体的、无需训练的视频扩散模型加速框架，通过五种技术（缓存、稀疏注意力、剪枝、量化、核融合）的实例化组合，在三种视频模型上实现2倍以上加速且保持质量无损。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型规模增大带来高推理成本，且最优加速策略高度依赖于具体实例（模型、硬件、推理配置的组合），手动调优成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出Sol Video Inference Engine，包含五种通用加速技术（缓存、稀疏注意力、token剪枝、量化、核融合），通过并行技能智能体优化各技术实现，再由智能体集成器组合成全局加速栈，最后由人类验证者提供质量反馈。
AI.result: 在三种视频模型（64B Cosmos3-Super、22B LTX-2.3、2B SANA-Video）上，以极少人工投入实现2倍以上端到端加速，同时保持近乎无损的VBench质量。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体框架有效解决了视频扩散模型加速的实例特异性问题，展示了自动化加速优化的可行性。

title: Can Language Model Agents be Helpful Circuit Explainers in Mechanistic Interpretability?
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has made substantial progress in automatically localizing circuits, but explaining what localized components do remains labor-intensive and difficult to standardize. In this work, we study whether language model (LM) agents can assist with this explanation problem once a circuit has already been identified. We introduce AgenticInterpBench, a benchmark for circuit explanation built from 84 semi-synthetic transformer circuits with 163 component-level annotations. We propose HyVE (Hypothesize, Validate, Explain), an agentic explainer that analyzes each component through an iterative loop of observation, hypothesis generation, and causal validation, eventually producing a component-level explanation and a circuit-level task description. Across four LM backbones, HyVE recovers useful component- and task-level explanations, but no backbone is uniformly best. Our analysis shows that strong backbones usually form observation-grounded hypotheses, while failures more often arise later in the validation loop, through incomplete validation plans, code execution errors, or unresolved hypotheses. A case study on an arithmetic circuit in Llama-3-8B shows that the same formulation can extend beyond semi-synthetic benchmarks to naturally trained models. Overall, LM agents are promising circuit explainers, but reliable validation remains the key obstacle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LM智能体辅助电路解释的能力，提出了AgenticInterpBench基准和HyVE解释方法。实验表明LM智能体能生成有用的解释，但可靠验证仍是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性在自动定位电路方面取得了进展，但解释这些电路组件的功能仍然耗时且难以标准化。作者希望利用LM智能体来辅助这一解释过程。
AI.method: 提出了AgenticInterpBench基准（包含84个半合成变压器电路和163个组件级标注）和HyVE解释方法（通过观察、假设生成、因果验证的迭代循环，最终生成组件级解释和电路级任务描述）。
AI.result: HyVE在四个LM骨干模型上都能恢复有用的组件级和任务级解释，但没有一个骨干模型是全面最优的。强骨干模型通常能形成基于观察的假设，而失败更多出现在验证循环后期，包括验证计划不完整、代码执行错误或假设未解决。
AI.conclusion: LM智能体作为电路解释工具有前景，但可靠验证仍是关键障碍。

title: Quantifying Prior Dominance in RAG Systems
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models in external knowledge, yet current evaluations rely on discrete heuristics that suffer from ''epistemic blindness'' - failing to distinguish genuine contextual information extraction from parametric memory recall. To address this, we introduce the Normalized Context Utilization (NCU) metric, leveraging continuous token log-probabilities across zero-shot, oracle, and adversarial conditions to strictly quantify contextual information gain. Evaluating architectures ranging from 1.5B to 72B parameters alongside a proprietary commercial API reveals that for strict factual extraction (without Chain-of-Thought reasoning), traditional scaling laws exhibit extreme diminishing returns: highly efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) match or outperform high-capacity architectures. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ``Prior Dominance'' correlates with model scale and proprietary alignments. The evaluated commercial API not only overrode explicit external evidence in nearly half of adversarial conflicts, but also frequently suffered from systemic confidence collapse (Negative Transfer) when its parametric priors were contradicted. Our findings highlight the structural epistemic advantage and superior contextual adherence of SLMs in strict extraction workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出NCU指标量化RAG中模型对上下文信息的利用程度，发现小语言模型在严格事实抽取任务中比大模型更具优势，商业API存在严重的先验主导和负迁移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评估依赖离散启发式方法，存在"认知盲区"，无法区分模型是真正利用外部上下文还是依赖参数记忆。
AI.method: 提出Normalized Context Utilization (NCU)指标，通过连续token对数概率在zero-shot、oracle和adversarial三种条件下严格量化上下文信息增益。
AI.result: 1）严格事实抽取中，传统缩放律出现极端边际收益递减，SLM可媲美甚至超越大模型；2）"先验主导"与模型规模和商业对齐相关；3）商业API在近半数对抗冲突中覆盖外部证据，且频繁出现信心崩塌（负迁移）。
AI.conclusion: 在严格抽取任务中，小语言模型具有结构性认知优势和更好的上下文遵循能力。

title: Listening makes Vision Clear for VLMs
summary: Recent work typically assesses vision--language consistency using attention distributions of answer-side tokens. However, we observe that highest attention regions are not always consistent with the intended semantic token. This probably stems from decoding drift, where language priors from previously generated answer tokens accumulate and mismatch with visual attention. Besides the priors from previous answer tokens, we find that structural tokens, e.g., modality boundary markers, may encompass the entire context and generate high attention to areas unrelated to the target. To avoid these distortions and provide consistency evaluation for large VLMs, we adopt prompt-side semantics and propose Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map (PV-TAM). PV-TAM further incorporates a filter to remove systematic bias induced by modality boundary markers. Unlike traditional methods that evaluate overlap solely through masks while ignoring activation intensity, our metrics leverage the peak distribution of attention to measure the alignment between prompts and visual regions. In experiments, PV-TAM consistently improves both attention-based and IoU-style localization metrics over answer-side baselines on various datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出PV-TAM方法，利用提示侧语义和注意力峰值分布来评估大型视觉语言模型的视觉-语言一致性，解决了答案侧注意力分布存在的解码漂移和结构标记干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用答案侧注意力分布评估视觉-语言一致性，但存在解码漂移（先前生成token的语言先验累积导致与视觉注意力不匹配）和结构标记（如模态边界标记）包含整个上下文并产生与目标无关的高注意力，导致评估不准确。
AI.method: 提出PV-TAM（提示-视觉令牌激活图），采用提示侧语义，并引入滤波器去除模态边界标记引起的系统偏差；利用注意力峰值分布而非传统的掩码重叠来衡量提示与视觉区域的对齐。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，PV-TAM在基于注意力的指标和IoU风格的定位指标上均一致优于答案侧基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PV-TAM通过聚焦提示侧语义和峰值注意力分布，有效避免了答案侧的解码漂移和结构标记干扰，为大型视觉语言模型提供了更可靠的视觉-语言一致性评估方法。

title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation
comment: IEEE International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (IRAI) - 2026
summary: Recommender systems often induce filter bubbles and semantic homogenization by monolithically optimizing for immediate user engagement. Standard single-objective models, including traditional Deep Q-Networks, are ill-equipped to navigate the trade-offs between platform retention and critical societal values like information diversity and provider fairness. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that formalizes recommendation as a semantic multi-objective Markov decision process. By integrating high-fidelity semantic embeddings with a Pareto-DQN agent, our architecture treats engagement, diversity, and fairness as distinct, non-aggregable reward signals, avoiding the pitfalls of static reward scalarization. Empirical evaluations on the MovieLens small dataset shows that our hypervolume based action selection disrupts the feedback loops responsible for semantic collapse. By sustaining high state-trajectory variance, the Pareto-DQN effectively maps the Pareto frontier, achieving gains in auxiliary societal objectives with only marginal impacts on engagement. This work provides a path toward intrinsically aligned, responsible recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多目标强化学习的推荐系统框架（Pareto-DQN），通过将语义嵌入与Pareto优化结合，在保持用户参与度的同时提升信息多样性和推荐公平性，有效缓解了推荐系统中的过滤气泡和语义同质化问题。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统单一优化用户即时参与度，导致过滤气泡和语义同质化，难以平衡平台留存与社会价值（如信息多样性和公平性）。
AI.method: 将推荐形式化为语义多目标马尔可夫决策过程，利用高保真语义嵌入与Pareto-DQN智能体，将参与度、多样性和公平性作为独立奖励信号，通过超体积动作选择映射Pareto前沿。
AI.result: 在MovieLens小数据集上，该方法通过维持高状态轨迹方差，有效破坏了语义崩溃的反馈循环，在仅轻微影响参与度的前提下显著提升了辅助社会目标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建内在对齐、负责任的推荐系统提供了可行路径。

title: Self-Recognition Finetuning can Prevent and Reverse Emergent Misalignment
summary: Emergent misalignment (EM) has been linked to the activation of misaligned persona vectors and evil character traits, suggesting that EM operates through disruption of the model's aligned character rather than direct learning of harmful content. Motivated by this connection, we study self-generated text recognition (SGTR) finetuning as a character-targeted intervention that is distinct from existing in-training defenses. We conduct two-stage finetuning experiments across three models (GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct) and multiple EM datasets to compare SGTR finetuning against benign finetuning baselines (correct domain-specific data, general knowledge, and word counting) to find it an effective defense in both reversal and prevention settings. We find that all interventions produce comparable EM reversal, but only when restoring capabilities that EM had degraded. For prevention, only SGTR finetuning consistently reduces misalignment without exacerbating any individual metric, suggesting that character fortification specifically drives prevention. We provide further evidence for EM's relation to the LLM's default character by showing that EM finetuning induces diversity into the LLM's identity self-reports, artificially corrupting self-recognition exacerbates misalignment caused by EM finetuning, and that removing the model's identity-bearing system prompt substantially reduces the effect of EM finetuning. Together, these findings reframe EM not as the adoption of a coherent misaligned persona but as the destabilization of aligned character.

AI.tldr: 本文发现突现失调（EM）本质是对模型对齐人格的失稳而非学习有害内容，提出自生成文本识别（SGTR）微调作为针对性的角色防御，实验表明SGTR在预防EM方面优于基线方法，并通过多项实验进一步证明EM与模型默认人格的关系。
AI.motivation: 已有研究将EM与失调人格向量和邪恶角色特征的激活联系起来，暗示EM是通过破坏模型的对齐角色而非直接学习有害内容起作用的，这启发了作者从角色保护角度探索防御方法。
AI.method: 在三个模型（GPT-4.1、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct）和多个EM数据集上进行两阶段微调实验，比较SGTR微调与良性微调基线（正确领域数据、通用知识、单词计数）在EM逆转和预防上的效果，并通过身份自报告多样性、人为破坏自识别等实验进一步验证EM机制。
AI.result: 所有干预在恢复EM退化的能力时都能逆转EM，但只有SGTR微调能一致地减少失调而不恶化任何单项指标；EM微调会导致模型身份自报告的多样性增加，人为破坏自识别会加剧失调，移除身份引导系统提示则显著削弱EM效果。
AI.conclusion: EM不应被理解为采纳连贯的失调人格，而是对齐人格的失稳；SGTR微调通过强化角色特质实现对EM的有效预防。

title: Evaluating LLM Usage for Efficient and Explainable Numerical and Classified Implicit Sentiment Analysis of Product Desirability
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2408.01527
summary:
Qualitative product feedback can reveal nuanced user experiences, but its implicit sentiment is difficult to measure. This paper presents a scalable and interpretable framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to quantify product desirability from such data. Using two Product Desirability Toolkit (PDT) datasets from ZORQ and CARMA comprising 106 respondent term groupings with gold-standard human annotation, zero-shot continuous numerical sentiment scoring and categorical sentiment classification are evaluated without relying on explicit review scores. Across the datasets, LLMs generated numerical sentiment scores directly from qualitative responses and closely matched expert labels, achieving Pearson correlations up to 0.97 and classification accuracy up to 94%. LLMs maintained robustness even when handling data presented in multiple forms and consistently expressed high confidence. In contrast, lexicon-based and transformer baselines did not produce statistically significant results. Among the models tested, GPT-4o-mini achieved performance comparable to larger models at 94% lower cost, supporting scalable deployment.
  The framework also incorporates model confidence ratings and human-readable rationale explanations (xAI), improving interpretability, transparency, and trust while supporting practical use in product satisfaction assessment. In general, using the PDT tool as a survey method along with a cost efficient LLM for sentiment analysis has the potential to provide for product evaluation with results that are rich in terms of sentiment scores (both numerical and classified sentiment) and in terms of the high-level user impressions of the product that can be used to identify ideas for product development and improvement, as well as marketing ideas for target audiences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展且可解释的框架，利用大语言模型（LLMs）量化产品反馈中的情感，在PDT数据集上达到高达0.97的皮尔逊相关性和94%的分类准确率，GPT-4o-mini以94%更低的成本实现与大模型相当的性能，并整合了模型置信度和可解释AI（xAI）提升透明度。
AI.motivation: 质性产品反馈蕴含细微的用户体验，但其隐含情感难以量化衡量，现有方法缺乏可扩展性和可解释性。
AI.method: 使用LLMs进行零样本连续数值情感评分和分类情感评估，结合模型置信度评分和可读性理由解释（xAI），在PDT数据集（ZORQ和CARMA，共106组受访者术语）上测试。
AI.result: LLMs生成的数值情感评分与专家标签高度匹配，皮尔逊相关性最高达0.97，分类准确率最高达94%；GPT-4o-mini以94%更低成本达到与大模型相当的性能；词典和Transformer基线未产生统计显著结果。
AI.conclusion: 结合PDT调查方法与成本高效的LLM情感分析，可提供丰富的数值和分类情感评分及高层次用户印象，支持产品开发改进和营销定位。

title: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
summary: ABACUS is a unified vision-language model that handles object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation without any benchmark-specific training required. Our model is built on existing 3B-parameter unified foundation model and is adapted for object localization tasks using three key innovations: density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for spatial grounding; a boundary-aware count policy via GRPO to eliminate crop-boundary errors; and a cycle-consistent GRPO strategy where the understanding branch self-critiques generated outputs, closing the understanding-generation gap without any external annotations. ABACUS achieves state-of-the-art results across seven benchmarks, outperforming both task-specific specialists and larger generalist models.

AI.tldr: ABACUS是一个统一视觉语言模型，通过密度感知自适应缩放、边界感知计数策略和循环一致性GRPO三大创新，无需基准特定训练即可处理多种计数任务，在七个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在物体计数、人群计数、指代表达计数和忠实计数图像生成等任务上需要各自独立训练，缺乏统一的解决方案，且理解和生成之间存在差距。
AI.method: 基于3B参数统一基础模型，提出三个创新：1）密度感知自适应缩放+物体性图实现空间定位；2）基于GRPO的边界感知计数策略消除裁剪边界错误；3）循环一致性GRPO策略让理解分支自我批评生成输出，无需外部标注即可弥合理解-生成鸿沟。
AI.result: 在七个基准上取得最先进结果，超越任务特定专家模型和更大的通用模型。
AI.conclusion: ABACUS证明了统一架构下无需基准特定训练即可同时处理多种计数相关任务的有效性，为视觉语言模型的通用计数能力提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Trajectory Imitation: Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation. SGPO extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong-model responses and, for each problem, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories to enable direct comparison of the model's behavior with and without strategic guidance. The framework then addresses two key questions. For how to distill, a token-level forward-KL objective selectively transfers the distributional shift induced by strategy conditioning into the unguided policy, with proximal constraints ensuring stability. For when to distill, adaptive instance-level weighting strengthens guidance when autonomous exploration falls short and reduces it as the model's own competence grows. Experiments on four mathematical benchmarks across two model families show that SGPO consistently outperforms SFT, on-policy RL, and hybrid-policy baselines, improving the average score by 2.2 points over the strongest baseline on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Analysis reveals that the forward-KL objective provides an inherently selective distillation signal that outperforms direct trajectory imitation, and that strategy distillation exhibits complementary scaling with base model capability.

AI.tldr: 提出策略引导策略优化（SGPO），用可复用的策略蒸馏替代轨迹级模仿，通过前向KL散度和自适应实例级权重，有效提升弱模型的推理泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统从强到弱模型的推理能力蒸馏通常模仿特定解题轨迹，这只能迁移"回答什么"而非"如何推理"，导致模型记忆实例步骤而非获取可迁移的解题技能，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: SGPO框架：1）从强模型响应中提取结构化策略描述；2）为每个问题构建自主轨迹和策略引导轨迹进行对比；3）使用token级前向KL散度选择性迁移策略条件化带来的分布偏移；4）采用自适应实例级权重，在自主探索不足时加强引导，能力增长时减弱引导。
AI.result: 在四个数学基准、两个模型族上，SGPO一致优于SFT、同策略RL和混合策略基线，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上平均提升2.2个百分点。前向KL目标比直接轨迹模仿更具选择性，策略蒸馏与基座模型能力呈互补缩放。
AI.conclusion: SGPO证明了用可复用策略替代轨迹级模仿进行推理能力蒸馏的有效性，为弱模型的泛化推理能力提升提供了新范式。

title: Ground Then Rank: Revisiting Knowledge-Based VQA with Training-Free Entity Identification
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Findings. Project page https://github.com/VAN-QIAN/ACL26-IBA/
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires grounding visual queries to external knowledge beyond directly observable content in images. While recent multi modal large language models (MLLMs) show strong perceptual abilities, they struggle on KB-VQA tasks requiring groundings from both fine-grained entity and evidence levels. Most existing multi-modal retrieval augmented generation (MM-RAG) methods tightly couple entity discrimination and section-level evidence ranking into a single re-ranking stage, leading to high cost and limited generalization. In this work, we revisit existing MM-RAG solutions from a workflow perspective and argue both entity-level and fact-level groundings are key bottlenecks. We observe that although MLLMs often fail under open-ended entity naming, they can better identify the correct entity when selecting from a small set of candidate names. Based on this insight, we propose a simple and training-free identify-before-answer IBA framework that decouples entity identification from section-level re-ranking. Our approach prompts an MLLM to select high-confidence entities using only candidate names, followed by an off-the-shelf textual re-ranker for evidence selection. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuned multi-modal re-ranking baselines while reducing training and inference complexity. Additional analyses reveal that the improvements arise not only from better entity identification, but also from selecting more informative evidence once correct entity is fixed. Our implementation is made public to ease reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的IBA框架，通过解耦实体识别与证据重排序，显著提升了多模态大模型在知识型视觉问答任务上的表现，同时降低了计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有MM-RAG方法将实体判别与段落级证据排序捆绑在同一重排序阶段，导致成本高、泛化性差；同时MLLMs在开放实体命名任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出IBA框架：先让MLLM从候选实体名称中选出高置信度实体，再使用现成的文本重排序器进行证据选择，实现实体识别与重排序的解耦。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek数据集上，IBA方法持续优于经过微调的多模态重排序基线，同时降低了训练和推理复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升不仅来自更好的实体识别，也来自在正确实体固定后能选择更具信息量的证据。代码已开源以促进可复现性。

title: HANCLIP: A Family of Hyperbolic Angular Negation Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are typically pre-trained on large-scale image-text datasets to capture semantic correspondences between visual content and natural language. However, they remain surprisingly brittle to negation: models often rely on shallow word co-occurrence and are easily distracted by misleading or irrelevant textual cues, even when their overall retrieval or classification performance is strong. Moreover, directly finetuning on negation data can interfere with previously acquired knowledge, causing noticeable degradation on standard vision-language benchmarks. To tackle these issues, this work introduces HANCLIP (Hyperbolic + Angular + Negation), a family of VLMs that explicitly restructures the embedding space to encode "what an image is not" alongside "what it is." HANCLIP is trained on a compact set of 20,000 image-text quadruplets and combines a hyperbolic formulation, which models hierarchical semantic relations and asymmetries, with an angular triplet objective that drives systematic separation between negated descriptions and their corresponding positives. This geometry-aware design strengthens negation sensitivity while preserving the global structure of pretrained representations, rather than overwriting them. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language tasks show that HANCLIP delivers consistent gains on the negation-focused NegBench benchmark, while maintaining competitive or improved performance on standard classification and image-text retrieval benchmarks. The framework is model-agnostic and can be plugged into CLIP, LongCLIP, SmartCLIP, and HiMo-CLIP without large-scale retraining, demonstrating that a carefully designed geometric objective can substantially extend the reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs using only modest additional data.

AI.tldr: HANCLIP通过双曲空间和角度三元组损失重新组织视觉语言模型的嵌入空间，仅用2万图像-文本四元组训练即可增强否定推理能力，同时保持标准任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM对否定表述（negation）非常脆弱，容易依赖浅层词共现关系，且直接微调否定数据会干扰已学知识，导致标准基准性能下降。
AI.method: 提出HANCLIP框架：1) 双曲空间公式建模层级语义关系与非对称性；2) 角度三元组目标函数系统性地分离否定描述与其对应肯定描述；3) 在2万图像-文本四元组上训练，模型无关，可即插即用于CLIP等模型。
AI.result: 在NegBench上持续提升否定理解能力，同时在标准分类和检索基准上保持竞争性或更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的几何目标函数可以用少量额外数据显著扩展现有VLM的推理能力，且不牺牲已有知识。

title: Exploring Academic Influence of Algorithms by Co-occurrence Network Based on Full-text of Academic Papers
summary: Algorithms have become central to scientific research in the era of artificial intelligence (AI). Although algorithm mentions in papers are often used to indicate popularity and influence, existing studies usually evaluate individual algorithms in isolation and pay limited attention to the collective influence formed through their interconnections. This study constructs large-scale algorithm co-occurrence networks in natural language processing (NLP) based on the full text of academic papers and investigates algorithm influence from a network perspective. Using deep learning models, we extract algorithm entities and build overall, cumulative, and annual co-occurrence networks. We analyze their structural characteristics and apply multiple centrality measures to assess the group influence of algorithms across the whole field and over time. The results show that algorithm networks display typical features of complex networks, with increasingly dense connections developing over approximately two decades. Classic, high-performing algorithms and those located at the intersections of different research periods tend to have high popularity, control, centrality, and balanced influence. When the influence of an algorithm declines, it usually loses its core network position first, followed by weaker associations with other algorithms. This study is the first large-scale analysis of algorithm co-occurrence networks. Covering more than four decades of academic publications, it provides a temporal and structural view of algorithm influence and offers a foundation for future research on networks linking algorithms, scholars, and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于学术论文全文，构建了NLP领域的算法共现网络，从网络视角分析了算法的群体影响力，发现经典和高性能算法以及处于不同研究时期交界的算法具有更高的控制力与中心性，算法影响力下降通常先失去核心网络位置。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常孤立地评估单个算法的影响力，忽视了算法之间通过相互连接形成的集体影响力。
AI.method: 使用深度学习模型从学术论文全文中提取算法实体，构建整体、累积和年度共现网络，采用多种中心性指标评估算法的群体影响力。
AI.result: 算法网络呈现出复杂网络的典型特征，连接密度在约二十年间不断增加；经典、高性能以及处于不同研究时期交界的算法具有高流行度、控制力、中心性和均衡的影响力；算法影响力下降时，首先失去核心网络位置，随后与其他算法的关联减弱。
AI.conclusion: 本研究是首次大规模算法共现网络分析，覆盖四十多年的学术出版物，为未来研究算法、学者和任务之间的网络关系提供了基础。

title: Mind the Heads: Topological Representation Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Representation alignment has emerged as an effective approach to improve Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by regularizing their internal representations toward those of an external vision encoder. However, existing methods typically align a fixed layer of the language backbone, overlooking the fine-grained structure of Transformer models. In this work, we propose Head-Wise Representation Alignment (HeRA), a method that enforces cross-modal alignment at the level of individual attention heads. Our approach is grounded in the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, focusing on preserving the topological structure of representations (i.e., their local neighborhood relationships) across modalities. Following the Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor (MKNN) alignment metric, we introduce a contrastive objective that acts as a differentiable proxy for matching local structures. HeRA applies this objective during multimodal training to specific attention heads in the LLM, selected by their alignment score according to the MKNN metric. Counterintuitively, we find that aligning the least aligned heads yields the largest gains. Extensive evaluations across multiple MLLMs and 18 benchmarks demonstrate that HeRA consistently improves performance on challenging vision-centric tasks and serves as an effective regularizer against visual hallucinations by naturally curbing the over-reliance on linguistic priors. Our code is publicly released.

AI.tldr: HeRA方法通过注意力头级别的表征对齐来改进多模态大模型，利用MKNN指标选择最不对齐的头进行对比学习，在18个基准测试上有效提升视觉任务性能并减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有表征对齐方法仅对齐语言骨干网络的固定层，忽略了Transformer模型中注意力头的细粒度结构，未能充分利用不同头部的对齐潜力。
AI.method: 提出HeRA方法，在注意力头级别进行跨模态对齐。基于柏拉图表征假说，使用MKNN指标衡量拓扑结构相似性，引入对比学习目标作为可微代理，选择对齐分数最低的注意力头进行对齐训练。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM和18个基准测试上持续提升视觉任务性能，有效减少视觉幻觉，表现为对语言先验过度依赖的自然抑制。
AI.conclusion: 头级别的细粒度对齐比层级别的对齐更有效，且对齐最不对齐的头（而非最对齐的头）能带来最大收益，为多模态表征对齐提供了新的优化方向。

title: ReMMD: Realistic Multilingual Multi-Image Agentic Verification for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
comment: The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD
summary: Multimodal misinformation detection is increasingly important because viral posts now combine long multilingual narratives, several images, mixed provenance, and subtle text--image framing errors. Existing benchmarks and methods remain poorly matched to this setting: they usually isolate short captions, single images, binary labels, or one manipulation source, while agentic verification remains costly under realistic evidence search. We present ReMMD, a realistic multilingual multi-image agentic verification framework for multimodal misinformation detection. ReMMD includes ReMMDBench, a real-world multimodal misinformation detection benchmark with 500 samples, 2,756 images, five monolingual languages, two cross-lingual settings, three text-length tiers, multi-image posts, five-way veracity labels, eight distortion labels, evidence provenance, and rationales. It also includes ReMMD-Agent, a persistent-memory verifier that decomposes posts into atomic points, builds a reusable evidence set, and predicts structured L1/L2/L3 outputs. Across proprietary systems, open LVLMs, MMD-Agent, and T2-Agent, ReMMD-Agent obtains the best five-way veracity performance, with 41.80% accuracy and 39.12% macro-F1 using GPT-5.2, while reducing cost by 17.5% relative to MMD-Agent and 79.9% relative to T2-Agent. The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReMMD框架，包含一个真实世界的多语言多图像虚假信息检测基准ReMMDBench（500样本，2756张图像，支持5种语言）和一个基于持久化记忆的智能体验证器ReMMD-Agent。ReMMD-Agent通过分解帖子为原子点、构建可复用证据集并输出结构化L1/L2/L3预测，在五类真实性分类上达到最优性能（准确率41.80%，宏F1 39.12%），同时比基线方法降低17.5%-79.9%的成本。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态虚假信息检测基准和方法难以应对现实场景中长文本、多语言、多图像混合、来源混杂以及文本-图像细微错误的复杂挑战，且基于智能体的验证在现实证据搜索下成本高昂。
AI.method: ReMMD框架包含两大组件：1) ReMMDBench：包含500个样本、2756张图像的五种单语及两种跨语言设置的真实世界基准，支持多图像帖子、五类真实性标签、八类扭曲标签及证据溯源；2) ReMMD-Agent：持久化记忆验证器，将帖子分解为原子点，构建可复用证据集，输出L1/L2/L3结构化预测。
AI.result: 在闭源系统、开源LVLM、MMD-Agent和T2-Agent的对比中，ReMMD-Agent使用GPT-5.2取得最优五类真实性分类性能（准确率41.80%，宏F1 39.12%），同时成本比MMD-Agent降低17.5%，比T2-Agent降低79.9%。
AI.conclusion: ReMMD框架有效解决了现实场景下多语言多图像虚假信息检测的挑战，在提升检测性能的同时大幅降低了智能体验证成本。

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
title: Do LLM Attribution Metrics Transfer? Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Across Datasets and Constructs
summary: Practice often treats automatic metrics for attribution in LLM retrieval-augmented generation as interchangeable. We audit eight automatic scorers -- lexical, embedding, and BERTScore baselines alongside entailment/grounding-trained models (clean and FEVER NLI, the checker MiniCheck) -- across three evaluation constructs (provenance/topicality, generated-answer attribution, and fact-check entailment), asking whether any scorer transfers: stays within the 95% confidence interval of the best audited scorer on every dataset of a multi-dataset construct. In the construct with the most multi-dataset human-labeled coverage -- generated-answer attribution (AttributionBench's four source datasets, n = 1,610, with independent HAGRID, n = 2,150) -- none does: the per-dataset metric rankings invert (Kendall tau = -0.64, p = 0.031 on AttributedQA vs. LFQA), and an off-the-shelf NLI scorer that is best on short-claim AttributedQA (AUROC 0.90) collapses to AUROC 0.53 (chance) on long-form LFQA, where BERTScore wins (0.91); the flip is not a length or truncation artifact. This instability has a concrete decision cost: a naive "best-on-average" rule for choosing an evaluator fails leave-one-dataset-out (mean held-out regret 0.172 AUROC, worse than fixing one scorer), so metric choice must be validated on the target dataset rather than learned from others. A prompt-based LLM judge avoids the chance-level collapses the automatic scorers suffer (no LFQA collapse) but is not uniformly best, ~100x costlier, and non-deterministic -- relocating, not removing, the validation burden.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了八种自动评估指标在LLM检索增强生成中的归因任务表现，发现没有任何一种指标能在多数据集上保持稳定最优，指标排名会随数据集反转，导致跨数据集迁移失败。直接使用LLM裁判可避免自动评分器的崩坏问题，但成本更高且不可靠。
AI.motivation: 实践中常将归因自动评估指标视为可互换的，但缺乏系统验证。作者希望探究这些指标是否能在不同数据集和评估构念之间稳定迁移。
AI.method: 审计八种自动评分器（词法、嵌入、BERTScore基线及蕴含/接地训练模型），覆盖三种评估构念（来源/主题性、生成答案归因、事实验证蕴含），通过多数据集交叉验证和留一法测试指标迁移能力。
AI.result: 在生成答案归因构念中，无指标能在所有数据集上保持95%置信区间内的最优表现；指标排名在数据集间反转（Kendall tau = -0.64）；最佳NLI评分器从AttributedQA的AUROC 0.90降至LFQA的0.53（随机水平）；"平均最优"选择策略的留一法平均遗憾值为0.172 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 自动归因指标存在严重的跨数据集不稳定性，指标选择必须在目标数据集上验证而非从其他数据学习。LLM裁判可避免崩坏但成本高且非确定性，并未根本解决问题。

title: REALM: A Unified Red-Teaming Benchmark for Physical-World VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as perception-reasoning backbones for embodied intelligence in safety-critical physical systems, where perception or reasoning errors can lead to unsafe decisions or actions. Although many red-teaming methods have been developed to probe VLM vulnerabilities, their evaluation remains fragmented across datasets, metrics, and threat models, making direct comparison difficult and obscuring whether observed differences arise from stronger attacks, more vulnerable models, or incompatible evaluation settings. Existing chatbot-centric red-teaming benchmarks mainly standardize jailbreak and content-safety evaluation, but they do not systematically capture physically grounded functional failures or cover red-teaming methods that target physical-world VLMs. This raises the key challenge of comparing diverse attack methods under a unified protocol while targeting the same scenario-specific failures. We introduce REALM, to our knowledge the first unified red-teaming benchmark for physical-world VLMs. REALM integrates 12 red-teaming methods, 3 model-agnostic defenses, and 13 VLMs under a practical black-box threat model with shared datasets and metrics. To align adversarial objectives across attack families, REALM introduces an agentic target-generation pipeline that constructs shared, scenario-specific, and physically grounded attack objectives for each scene, enabling fair comparison of diverse red-teaming methods under aligned adversarial goals. Our evaluation shows that text and typographic injection attacks induce the most failures, multimodal co-optimization yields the strongest visual-perturbation transfer, single-pass attacks approach iterative methods at much lower cost, and model scale alone does not confer adversarial robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/UCF-ML-Research/REALM.

AI.tldr: REALM是首个面向物理世界VLM的统一红队评测基准，整合了12种攻击方法、3种防御和13个VLM，在统一协议下实现公平比较。研究发现文本/排版注入攻击效果最强，多模态协同优化产生最强视觉扰动迁移，单轮攻击接近迭代方法效果但成本更低，且模型规模并不保证对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM红队评测分散于不同数据集、指标和威胁模型下，难以直接比较不同攻击方法的优劣。且现有基准主要关注聊天机器人的越狱和内容安全，缺乏对物理世界VLM的功能性失效的系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出REALM基准，集成12种红队攻击方法、3种模型无关防御和13个VLM，采用统一的黑盒威胁模型和共享数据集/指标。引入智能体目标生成流水线，为每个场景构建共享的、场景特定的、物理可落地的攻击目标，确保不同攻击方法在一致目标下可比。
AI.result: 文本和排版注入攻击诱导的失败最多；多模态协同优化产生最强的视觉扰动迁移效果；单轮攻击可以达到与迭代攻击相近的效果但成本更低；模型规模增大并不能直接带来更强的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: REALM为物理世界VLM的安全评估提供了首个统一基准，揭示了不同攻击方法的相对有效性，并为未来物理VLM安全研究奠定了基础。

title: VeryTrace: Verifying Reasoning Traces through Compilable Formalism and Structured Verification
summary:
Multi-step reasoning with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains fragile: logical errors or hallucinations in early steps silently propagate, producing confident but incorrect conclusions. This paper presents VeryTrace, a zero-shot verification-and-repair framework that formalizes natural-language reasoning traces into a structured, compilable representation. VeryTrace introduces a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that (i) makes step dependencies explicit, (ii) mechanizes quantitative content as executable expressions, and (iii) structures semantic inferences via deduction schemas. Our hybrid verifier combines deterministic checks for computational correctness, dependency resolution, and constraint satisfaction with targeted LLM audits for non-mechanizable semantic judgments, enabling step-level error localization and repair.
  Across three diverse domains-competition mathematics (AIME 2025), robotics planning (LLM-BabyBench), and kinship reasoning (CLUTRR), VeryTrace improves accuracy over zero-shot baselines on state-of-the-art LLMs without requiring domain-specific training or in-context examples, demonstrating that formalized trace verification achieves both precision and generalization.

AI.tldr: VeryTrace提出了一种零样本验证-修复框架，通过领域特定语言将自然语言推理轨迹形式化，结合确定性验证和LLM审计实现逐步错误定位与修复，在数学、机器人规划和亲属关系推理三个领域显著提升了准确率。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought推理中早期步骤的逻辑错误或幻觉会无声传播，导致自信但错误的结论，现有方法缺乏对推理轨迹的结构化验证机制。
AI.method: 设计领域特定语言(DSL)将自然语言推理轨迹形式化为可编译表示，明确步骤依赖关系，将量化内容转化为可执行表达式，通过演绎模式结构化语义推理；混合验证器结合确定性检查（计算正确性、依赖解析、约束满足）和LLM审计（处理不可机械化语义判断），实现逐级错误定位与修复。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025（竞赛数学）、LLM-BabyBench（机器人规划）和CLUTRR（亲属关系推理）三个领域，VeryTrace在零样本设置下均提升了最先进LLM的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 形式化轨迹验证在不依赖领域特定训练或上下文示例的情况下，同时实现了高精度和良好泛化能力，验证了结构化验证方法的有效性和通用性。

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
summary: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 for only 7% of airline states, the primary 3B classifier obtains macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses (Delta=-0.02, task-cluster 95% CI [-0.23,+0.21]); mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. We do not detect a macro-F1 difference between retrieved and gold clauses in this configuration, although the interval remains too wide to establish non-inferiority. The same qualitative pattern appears with a second retriever and at 7B, while varying across fine-tuning configurations. These results indicate that exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in this benchmark setting, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在tau-bench场景下，精确匹配的政策条款召回率并不能完全反映检索器对下游分类模型的实际效用。实验发现，虽然检索器仅对7%的状态能精确命中政策条款，但使用检索到的条款与使用黄金条款的分类性能差异很小（Macro-F1仅差-0.02），远优于无政策或错误政策的情况。这表明评估检索器时应结合下游分类性能，而非仅依赖召回率。
AI.motivation: 精确匹配召回率常被用作检索器能否为下游决策模型提供有用政策上下文的代理指标，但这种代理的可靠性尚未得到充分验证。本文旨在检验这一代理在政策分类任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 在tau-bench场景下进行预行动政策分类，使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器。对比黄金政策条件、检索到的政策条件（使用两种检索器）、错误政策条件以及无政策条件下的分类性能，以Macro-F1为主要评估指标。
AI.result: 在紧凑结构化状态下，黄金政策条件相比原始轨迹提升0.13-0.17 Macro-F1。尽管精确政策条款仅7%被排在首位检索到，但检索条款与黄金条款的Macro-F1差异仅为-0.02（0.58 vs 0.60），错误政策为0.32，无政策为0.21。该模式在两种检索器和7B模型上一致，但受限于置信区间宽度。
AI.conclusion: 精确匹配的条款召回率可能会低估检索器在下游政策分类中的实际效用，建议在分类环路中使用检索到的策略进行评估，而非仅依赖召回率指标。

title: The Professor: Multi-Teacher Unsupervised Prompt Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt distillation compresses large vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP into lightweight student models by matching teacher predictions on unlabeled domain images. PromptKD (CVPR 2024) established this paradigm with a single PromptSRC-finetuned ViT-L/14 teacher and a ViT-B/16 student. We propose TheProfessor, a multi-teacher extension that distills from a fixed two-teacher ensemble: a domain-finetuned PromptSRC ViT-L/14 teacher and a zero-shot EVA-CLIP-L/14 teacher whose logits are pre-computed per dataset. We evaluate single-teacher PromptKD, equal-probability ensembling, and confidence-weighted ensembling on four base-to-novel datasets: Caltech-101, DTD, UCF101, and EuroSAT. In a 12-run single-seed sweep, confidence-weighted ensembling improves average HM from 87.52 to 89.28 (+1.77 points), while equal averaging improves average HM to 88.88 (+1.37 points). Gains are dataset dependent: they are negligible on Caltech-101 (+0.16 HM for confidence weighting), modest on UCF101 (+0.62), and largest on domain-shifted EuroSAT (+5.78). These results update our earlier Caltech-only analysis and show that multi-teacher prompt distillation is most useful when the second teacher contributes complementary supervision under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TheProfessor，一种多教师提示蒸馏方法，通过融合领域微调教师和零样本教师，在领域偏移数据集上提升了分类性能，平均HM从87.52提升至89.28。
AI.motivation: 现有单教师蒸馏方法PromptKD在领域偏移场景下泛化能力有限，引入互补的多教师知识可提升学生模型性能。
AI.method: 采用固定双教师集成：PromptSRC微调的ViT-L/14教师（领域专家）+ 零样本EVA-CLIP-L/14教师（通用知识），分别测试等概率集成和置信度加权集成。
AI.result: 在4个数据集上，置信度加权集成平均HM提升1.77点，等概率集成提升1.37点；EuroSAT上提升最大（+5.78），Caltech-101提升最小（+0.16）。
AI.conclusion: 多教师提示蒸馏在领域偏移场景下最有效，互补教师知识能显著提升学生模型泛化能力。

title: OmniPath: A Multi-Modal Agentic Framework for Auditing Wheelchair Accessibility
comment: 10 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE COMPSAC 2026. OmniPath: A Multi-Modal Agentic Framework for Auditing Wheelchair Accessibility
summary: For a wheelchair user, a standard blue line on a map is often a broken promise. While platforms like OpenStreetMap (OSM) successfully capture where a path is, they frequently fail to convey how it physically feels to travel on it. This information barrier is problematic for wheelchair users. To solve this issue, we present OmniPath, a system that moves from passive mapping to proactive environmental auditing. Our framework fuses the network topology of OSM with the submeter precision of high-density aerial LiDAR (USGS 3DEP) to create a high-fidelity 3D model of the pedestrian environment. Rather than simply routing a user, our agent virtually traverses the network, analyzing the surface in 0.5 meter increments. It rigorously quantifies physical friction points specifically running slope, cross slope, and vertical discontinuities against ADA compliance standards, calculating a weighted severity score to categorize hazards from ``Mild'' to ``Critical.'' To ensure real world reliability, we validated the system against 200 physical ground truth field surveys across the National Mall using stratified random sampling. The framework demonstrated strong diagnostic reliability for high-severity hazards, achieving F1-scores of 0.60 for Severe and 0.58 for critical categories. By automating this micro-scale inspection, OmniPath identifies the ``invisible'' barriers that standard maps miss, effectively transforming a static dataset into accessibility data source that anticipates accessibility challenges before the user ever leaves home.

AI.tldr: OmniPath是一个将OSM路网与高密度LiDAR数据融合的系统，能自动检测行人环境中不符合ADA标准的物理障碍（坡度、横坡、垂直不连续点），以0.5米精度进行全网络虚拟遍历并生成严重性评分，在200个实地验证中高严重性障碍检测F1达0.58-0.60。
AI.motivation: 标准的数字地图（如OSM）虽然能记录路径位置，但无法传达轮椅使用者实际通行的体感，存在严重的信息障碍。
AI.method: 融合OSM网络拓扑与USGS 3DEP高密度机载LiDAR数据，构建高保真3D模型；通过智能体以0.5米增量虚拟遍历网络，量化运行坡度、横坡和垂直不连续点，对照ADA标准计算加权严重性评分，将障碍分为"Mild"到"Critical"等级。
AI.result: 在National Mall的200个实地验证中，高严重性障碍检测F1分数为：Severe 0.60，Critical 0.58。
AI.conclusion: OmniPath通过自动化微观检测，能够识别标准地图无法发现的"隐形"障碍，将静态数据集转化为可预见无障碍挑战的数据源，解决轮椅用户的信息鸿沟问题。

title: QuechuaTok: Morphological Boundary Accuracy as a Necessary Metric for Tokenizer Evaluation in Agglutinative Low-Resource Languages
comment: 4 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure. Code available at kaggle.com/code/macmaky/quechuatok
summary: Tokenization is a foundational step in NLP pipelines, yet standard evaluation metrics such as fertility rate fail to capture morphological correctness for agglutinative languages. We present QuechuaTok, a systematic benchmark comparing four tokenization strategies - BPE, Unigram LM, WordPiece, and a morphology-aware PRPE tokenizer - for Southern Quechua (quz), a low-resource agglutinative language spoken by 8-10 million people in South America. Using a 200k-sentence corpus and the SQUOIA finite-state morphological analyzer (Rios, 2016) as silver standard, we evaluate three metrics: fertility rate, OOV rate, and morphological boundary accuracy (MorphAcc). Our results show that BPE achieves the lowest fertility rate (1.636 at 16k vocab) by memorizing surface word forms, while achieving only 6.67% MorphAcc. PRPE achieves 83.33% MorphAcc - the highest of all systems - demonstrating that fertility rate alone is insufficient to evaluate tokenizers for agglutinative languages. All code and models are publicly available at kaggle.com/code/macmaky/quechuatok

AI.tldr: 本文提出了QuechuaTok基准测试，对比了四种分词策略（BPE、Unigram LM、WordPiece和PRPE）在南克丘亚语上的表现，发现传统评估指标（如fertility rate）无法反映黏着语的形态正确性，而PRPE方法在形态边界准确性上达到83.33%，远高于BPE的6.67%。
AI.motivation: 现有的分词评估指标（如fertility rate）对黏着语等形态丰富语言的形态正确性捕获不足，亟需更系统的评估方法。
AI.method: 使用20万句语料库和SQUOIA有限状态形态分析器作为银标准，比较BPE、Unigram LM、WordPiece和PRPE四种分词策略，采用fertility rate、OOV率和形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）三个指标进行评估。
AI.result: BPE在16k词表下取得最低fertility rate（1.636），但MorphAcc仅为6.67%；PRPE取得最高MorphAcc（83.33%），表明fertility rate不足以评估黏着语分词器。
AI.conclusion: 对于黏着语等低资源语言，需要形态感知的分词评估方法，单纯依赖fertility rate等传统指标会产生误导。

title: Trustworthy Image Authentication using Forensic Knowledge Graphs
summary: Advances in generative AI have made image falsification highly realistic, demanding trustworthy authentication systems. Existing forensic detectors can target certain forgery types but lack interpretability, while vision-language models (VLMs) provide explanations but cannot exploit forensic traces for reliable detection. We propose Forensic Knowledge Graphs (FKGs), a unified framework that integrates forensic evidence extraction, structured reasoning, and human-interpretable explanation. Our FKG structure encodes forensic traces along with their causal dependencies and links to scene content. To generate accurate FKGs, we introduce a novel forensic authentication network and an Iterative Context Refinement strategy that guides VLMs to produce faithful, grounded explanations. We also present FKG-50K, a dataset of 50,000 realistic forgeries with ground-truth FKGs. Experiments demonstrate that FKG outperforms both forensic detectors and VLMs in detection, forgery identification and localization, and forensic justification.

AI.tldr: 提出法医知识图谱(FKG)统一框架，通过结构化证据提取与推理实现图像伪造检测和可解释性，在检测、定位和解释任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪造检测器缺乏可解释性，而视觉语言模型虽能提供解释但无法有效利用法医证据进行可靠检测，因此需要一种既能检测伪造又能提供可解释的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建法医知识图谱(FKG)编码伪造痕迹及其因果依赖关系；提出法医认证网络和迭代上下文精炼策略引导VLM生成忠实解释；构建包含5万张伪造图像及对应FKG标注的FKG-50K数据集。
AI.result: FKG在检测、伪造识别与定位、法医解释任务上均优于现有法医检测器和视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 法医知识图谱是一种有效的统一框架，能够同时实现可靠的图像伪造检测和人类可理解的解释。

title: DivRL: Disentangled Self-Similarity Rewards for Diverse Subject-Driven Generation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://qianwangx.github.io/DivRL/
summary: Subject-driven image generation faces an "Identity-Diversity Paradox", where strong identity preservation often leads to rigid and low-diversity outputs. We propose a post-training framework called DivRL that jointly optimizes identity consistency and structural diversity simultaneously by leveraging disentangled visual features from a robust similarity model. Specifically, we introduce a Negative Self-Similarity Measure (nSSM) to quantify structural diversity, and Visual Semantic Matching (VSM) to evaluate identity consistency. We propose an "Explore-and-Suppress" strategy that treats VSM as a gated constraint: the model freely explores structurally diverse configurations, and only samples that violate the identity threshold are penalized via a quadratic hinge loss. This converts identity preservation from a competing objective into a feasibility constraint, allowing nSSM and VSM to improve jointly. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively pushes the model to generate both consistent and diverse images and improves structural diversity while maintaining comparable identity consistency through a gated optimization formulation.

AI.tldr: 提出DivRL框架，通过解耦视觉特征和"探索-抑制"策略，在保持身份一致性的同时提升图像生成的结构多样性，解决了身份-多样性悖论。
AI.motivation: 主体驱动图像生成面临"身份-多样性悖论"：强身份保持往往导致输出僵硬、多样性低。
AI.method: 提出DivRL后训练框架，利用负自相似度量(nSSM)量化结构多样性，视觉语义匹配(VSM)评估身份一致性；采用"探索-抑制"策略，将VSM作为门控约束，仅在违反身份阈值时通过二次铰链损失进行惩罚。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效生成既一致又多样的图像，在保持可比的身份一致性的同时提升了结构多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将身份保持从竞争目标转化为可行性约束的门控优化方式，实现了nSSM和VSM的联合提升。

title: The Geometry Behind Diffusion and Flow Matching: Gradient Flows and Geodesics in Wasserstein Space
summary: The space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathbb{R}^d$) of probability measures with finite second moment carries a natural geometry: the quadratic Wasserstein distance W_2 makes it a complete metric space and, following Otto, a (formal) Riemannian manifold whose geodesics are the optimal-transport interpolations. On this manifold, the gradient flow of the free energy F(rho) = KL(rho || π) is exactly the Fokker-Planck equation, and its implicit-Euler discretization is the JKO scheme. This is the geometry underlying diffusion models: the forward process descends the free energy, and each denoising step realizes one JKO step, which recovers DDPM, DDIM, NCSN/SMLD, and Energy Matching; this is one scheme, not separate theories. The same manifold supports a second variational principle. Its geodesics - the minimum-action curves of the Benamou-Brenier formula - are precisely the optimal-transport paths that Flow Matching learns. Fixing both endpoints and following the geodesic, generation becomes a deterministic ODE along a straight line, hence far fewer sampling steps. Placing both families of models on one manifold makes their relationship exact: diffusion follows a free-energy gradient flow, an initial-value problem; optimal-transport Flow Matching follows a Wasserstein geodesic, a boundary-value problem. The two reach the same endpoints along different paths.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型和最优传输流匹配（Flow Matching）共享同一几何基础——Wasserstein流形。扩散模型对应自由能的梯度流（初始值问题），流匹配对应Wasserstein测地线（边值问题），两者沿不同路径到达相同终点。DDPM、DDIM、NCSN/SMLD和Energy Matching均可统一为JKO格式。
AI.motivation: 将扩散模型和流匹配这两类生成模型统一到一个理论框架下，阐明它们之间的精确几何关系，澄清各自的理论基础并非独立而是同一几何的不同侧面。
AI.method: 在Wasserstein度量空间（Otto流形）上，将扩散模型解释为自由能KL(ρ||π)的梯度流（Fokker-Planck方程/JKO离散化），将流匹配解释为Benamou-Brenier最小作用量原理下的Wasserstein测地线（最优传输路径）。
AI.result: 论证了DDPM/DDIM/NCSN/SMLD/Energy Matching均可视为JKO一步实现；流匹配生成过程为沿直线确定性ODE，采样步数更少；两类模型在统一流形上的关系被精确刻画：扩散是初值问题，流匹配是边值问题。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型和最优传输流匹配是同一Wasserstein几何结构上的互补框架，各自沿不同路径（梯度流vs测地线）到达相同分布终点，为理解和改进生成模型提供了统一的视角。

title: Does My Embedding Reflect That $A = B$? Evaluating Mathematical Equivalence in Embedding Models
summary: Because mathematics is highly abstract, a single statement can take very different forms depending on what subfield it is framed in. There are many examples where breakthroughs occurred after researchers discovered that a question had already been answered in a different field. At the same time, the growth of new resources related to formalization has increased the need for tools that enable efficient and reliable navigation between mathematical 'languages' (e.g., from Lean to natural language). In this paper, we investigate whether current embedding models capture mathematical equivalence. To do this, we introduce the Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) Dataset, a collection of mathematically equivalent statements that are expressed in very different language. We show that current state-of-the-art embedding models tend to group statements by the terminology used to make them instead of the underlying math. Motivated by this, we propose a contrastive approach to learning embeddings of mathematical text that focuses on aligning informal statements with different formalizations. Our experiments demonstrate that this leads to improvements not only on informal-formal retrieval tasks but also on MELD, which only contains natural language statements.

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前嵌入模型倾向于按术语而非数学本质对数学语句分组，为此提出了MELD数据集和一种对比学习方法，能够更好地捕捉数学等价性。
AI.motivation: 数学具有高度抽象性，同一数学命题在不同子领域中表述差异巨大，但现有嵌入模型无法识别这种数学等价性，阻碍了跨领域的知识发现和形式化工具的发展。
AI.method: 构建了MELD数据集（数学等价但词汇不同的语句对），并提出一种对比学习方法，通过对齐非正式数学表述与不同的形式化表示来学习嵌入。
AI.result: 该方法不仅在非正式-形式化检索任务上表现更优，在仅包含自然语言语句的MELD数据集上也取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比学习对齐不同形式化的数学表述，可以有效提升嵌入模型对数学等价性的捕捉能力，为跨领域数学知识的导航和检索提供了新思路。

title: Token-to-Token Alignment of Text Embeddings for Semantic Blending
summary: In modern generative models, images are specified and controlled through text prompts. In practice, images are generated from sequences of tokens derived from these prompts. However, the space of token sequences lacks a consistent accessible structure: semantically similar images may correspond to sequences that differ in wording, ordering, and placement of concepts, while similar token sequences may encode very different semantics. This apparent lack of structure makes it difficult to perform smooth transitions in this space, hindering applications such as image blending and continuous control of edits. We argue that this limitation stems not from the absence of semantic structure, but from misalignment between representations. To address this misalignment, we introduce Token-to-Token alignment, a framework that establishes explicit semantic correspondence between tokens across prompts. Our approach transforms prompts into a structured representation in which semantically corresponding concepts are mapped to consistent positions across prompts, and then aligns their token embeddings based on semantic similarity. Concretely, the method consists of two stages: a structural alignment that rephrases prompts into a shared structured form, followed by an embedding-level alignment that matches token representations across prompts. With this alignment in place, simple linear interpolation becomes a meaningful operation, producing smooth and coherent semantic transitions and enabling applications such as blending and continuous editing. Our results show that text embedding spaces in text-to-image models implicitly encode a continuous semantic structure that becomes accessible once representations are properly aligned, suggesting that semantic control can be achieved by organizing existing representations rather than modifying the generative model.

AI.tldr: 提出Token-to-Token对齐框架，通过结构对齐和嵌入对齐解决文本到图像生成中token序列与语义不一致的问题，使得线性插值能产生平滑的语义过渡，实现图像融合和连续编辑。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像生成中，token序列空间缺乏一致的可访问结构——语义相似的图像可能对应不同的词序和措辞，而相似的token序列却可能编码不同的语义，导致难以在该空间中进行平滑过渡，阻碍了图像融合和连续编辑等应用。
AI.method: 提出Token-to-Token对齐框架，包含两个阶段：1) 结构对齐：将提示重写为共享的结构化形式，使语义对应的概念映射到跨提示的一致位置；2) 嵌入级对齐：基于语义相似性匹配跨提示的token表示。
AI.result: 在线性插值操作下产生平滑且连贯的语义过渡，实现了图像融合和连续编辑等应用。
AI.conclusion: 文本到图像模型中的文本嵌入空间隐式编码了连续的语义结构，一旦表示被正确对齐即可访问，表明语义控制可以通过组织现有表示而非修改生成模型来实现。

title: An Introduction to Causal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Causal inference provides a set of principles and tools that allow one to combine data and knowledge about an environment to reason with questions of counterfactual nature, i.e., what would have happened had reality been different, even when no data of this unrealized reality is currently available. Reinforcement learning provides methods to learn a policy that optimizes a specific measure (e.g., reward, regret) when the agent is deployed in an environment and pursues an exploratory, trial-and-error approach. These two disciplines have evolved independently and with virtually no interaction between them. We note that they operate over different aspects of the same building block, counterfactual relations, which makes them umbilically connected. Based on these observations, novel learning opportunities arise when this connection is explicitly acknowledged and mathematized. To realize this potential, we note that any environment where the RL agent is deployed can be decomposed as a collection of autonomous mechanisms with different causal invariances, parsimoniously modeled as a structural causal model; any standard RL setting implicitly encodes such a model. This formalization allows us to put under a unifying treatment different modes of learning, including online, off-policy, and causal calculus learning, which appear unrelated in the literature. However, these modalities are not exhaustive: we introduce several natural and pervasive classes of learning settings that entail novel dimensions of analysis. Specifically, we introduce and discuss through causal lenses generalized policy learning, where to intervene, imitation learning, and counterfactual learning. These tasks lead to a broader view of counterfactual learning and suggest great potential for studying causal inference and reinforcement learning side by side, which we call causal reinforcement learning (CRL).

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果强化学习（CRL）框架，将因果推断与强化学习统一建模，揭示了二者在反事实推理上的内在联系，并引入广义策略学习、模仿学习和反事实学习三类新学习范式。
AI.motivation: 因果推断和强化学习虽然都基于反事实关系，但长期独立发展、缺乏交互，导致许多潜在的学习机会未被发掘。
AI.method: 将RL环境分解为具有因果不变性的自主机制集合，建模为结构因果模型（SCM），从而统一处理在线学习、离线策略学习和因果演算学习，并在此基础上提出三类新学习范式。
AI.result: 揭示了三种现有学习模式（在线、离线、因果演算）的统一性，并引入了广义策略学习、模仿学习和反事实学习三种新学习设置。
AI.conclusion: 因果推断与强化学习的结合（CRL）为反事实学习提供了更广阔的视野，具有巨大的研究潜力。

title: Faithful by Construction: Claim-Anchored Attribution for Multi-Document Summarization
summary: End-to-end large language models (LLMs) produce fluent multi-document summaries but remain prone to hallucination, and the attributions they offer are typically coarse (whole documents or passages) and generated post hoc, leaving each summary statement hard to verify. We revisit the modular Extract--Select--Rewrite paradigm and recast its intermediate representation as the unit of attribution. We present CAMS, a Claim-Anchored Multi-document Summarization framework that (i) extracts atomic claims with token-level provenance from every source document, (ii) clusters equivalent claims across documents while flagging inter-source conflicts, (iii) selects a support-aware and salient subset, and (iv) rewrites the selection into a summary in which every sentence is anchored to a support-checked claim that links back to one or more source spans. Because content is localized before it is realized, the pipeline is attribution-oriented by construction and faithfulness-oriented by construction: it structurally preserves fine-grained, multi-source traceability while using support-aware selection, constrained rewriting, and verification to encourage, rather than guarantee, factual faithfulness. We evaluate quality, faithfulness, and localization on MultiNews, analyze conflict handling on DiverseSumm, and test zero-shot transfer on WCEP, using a two-regime protocol that separates reference-free citation quality from gold-aligned localization accuracy, and we add an evaluator-decoupled audit that tests citation precision with a support model never used for selection or verification. CAMS matches strong end-to-end and span-attribution baselines on summary quality while substantially improving faithfulness and citation precision, lifting multi-source attribution accuracy by roughly two-thirds, and exposing a controllable faithfulness--coverage trade-off that end-to-end models leave implicit.

AI.tldr: CAMS是一个基于声明锚点的多文档摘要框架，通过提取原子声明及其词级来源、跨文档聚类、支持感知选择和受限重写，实现细粒度、可溯源的摘要生成，在保持摘要质量的同时显著提升忠实度和引用精度。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端LLM在多文档摘要中容易产生幻觉，且归因粒度粗糙（整篇文档或段落）且事后生成，导致每个摘要语句难以验证。
AI.method: CAMS框架包含四个步骤：(i) 从每个源文档提取带词级来源的原子声明；(ii) 跨文档聚类等价声明并标记冲突；(iii) 选择支持可验证且重要性的子集；(iv) 将选择重写为摘要，每条句子锚定于支持可验证的声明，并链接回一个或多个源文本片段。
AI.result: CAMS在摘要质量上与强基线方法持平，同时在忠实度和引用精度上显著提升，将多源归因准确率提高约三分之二，并揭示了端到端模型隐含的可控忠实度-覆盖度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将内容在生成前本地化，CAMS在结构上保证了细粒度、多源可追溯性，并通过支持感知选择、受限重写和验证来促进——而非保证——事实忠实度，是一种归因导向和忠实度导向的框架。

title: DriveStack-VLA: Render-Teacher Alignment for BEV-Based DeepStack Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action driving models convert a pretrained Vision-Language Model into a driving policy, allowing them to use world knowledge and follow language guidances. However, existing VLA driving models still lack driving-oriented spatial intelligence: their policies are mainly grounded on perspective image tokens and language priors, while precise motion planning requires metric geometry, top-down scene structure, and attention to safety-critical perceptual cues. This limitation makes current models vulnerable to weak visual geometry modeling and perceptual coverage in expert demonstrations. In this paper, we present DriveStack-VLA, a framework built upon a large VLM backbone. To strengthen the spatial grounding of VLA driving, we develop dual visual modeling components. We inject a Bird-Eye-View representation into the Large Language Model decoder through a DeepStack-style connection, and propose Render-Teacher Alignment to align the perceptual focus of real images with that of rasterized images. Furthermore, to bridge the gap in multimodal trajectory selection, we introduce a head-based self-critique module that ranks sampled trajectories and conditionally refines the best one. DriveStack-VLA achieves 91.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1, 91.0 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 (with the human penalty filter enabled), and a driving score of 79.49 with a success rate of 56.36\% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive. More visualizations are available on our project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/drivestack-vla/.

AI.tldr: DriveStack-VLA通过引入双视觉建模（鸟瞰图+渲染教师对齐）和自批评模块，提升了VLA驾驶模型的空间感知能力和轨迹规划性能，在多个基准测试中取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA驾驶模型缺乏驾驶导向的空间智能，其策略主要依赖透视图像token和语言先验，缺乏精确的度量几何、自上而下的场景结构和安全关键感知线索，导致对弱视觉几何建模和专家示范中的感知覆盖不足。
AI.method: 1) 双视觉建模：通过DeepStack-style连接将BEV表示注入LLM解码器，并利用Render-Teacher Alignment对齐真实图像与栅格化图像的感知焦点。2) 基于头的自批评模块：对采样轨迹进行排序，并有条件地优化最佳轨迹。
AI.result: NAVSIMv1上PDMS 91.6，NAVSIMv2上EPDMS 91.0（开启人类惩罚过滤），闭环Bench2Drive上驾驶得分79.49，成功率56.36%。
AI.conclusion: DriveStack-VLA通过增强空间感知和多模态轨迹选择，有效弥补了现有VLA驾驶模型的空间智能不足，在开环和闭环评估中均显著提升性能。

title: EPEdit: Redefining Image Editing with Generative AI and User-Centric Design
summary: The demand for image manipulation has seen a significant increase recently. Traditional tools like Photoshop and Capture One, while powerful, require considerable expertise to use effectively. Generative AI has introduced alternative platforms, such as Luminar Neo, Pixlr X, and Canva. However, many of these solutions, including resource-heavy models like Stable Diffusion, often require substantial retraining and fine-tuning, leading to high costs for users. To address these challenges, we introduce Efficient Photo Editor (EPEdit), an application that integrates a robust backend framework with a user-friendly front-end interface. EPEdit supports a wide range of creative image editing tasks, including image generation, object replacement, object removal, background modification, changes in object pose or perspective, region-specific editing, and thematic collection design, all guided by masks and prompts. Users can interact with the system through simple text commands or by marking areas for precise adjustments, making it accessible even to those without technical expertise. At its core, EPEdit leverages zero-shot image editing algorithms based on Stable Diffusion model, removing the need for additional fine-tuning. This approach enables efficient image manipulation and thematic collection creation. User evaluations for tasks of image editing, thematic design, and overall system performance demonstrate that EPEdit outperforms existing solutions, offering a user-friendly, cost-effective solution for comprehensive image editing.

AI.tldr: EPEdit是一个基于零样本图像编辑算法的智能照片编辑器，无需微调即可通过文本指令和区域标记实现多种图像编辑功能，在用户体验和成本效益上优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑工具（如Photoshop）需要专业知识，而生成式AI方案（如Stable Diffusion）需要大量重新训练和微调，成本高昂。为了解决这些痛点，需要一种既易用又低成本的图像编辑方案。
AI.method: EPEdit采用零样本（zero-shot）图像编辑算法，基于Stable Diffusion模型，无需额外微调。系统集成后端框架与前端界面，用户通过文本指令或区域标记实现图像生成、对象替换/移除、背景修改、姿态变换、区域编辑等多种功能。
AI.result: 用户评估显示，EPEdit在图像编辑、主题设计和整体系统性能方面均优于现有解决方案，实现了用户友好且成本效益高的综合性图像编辑。
AI.conclusion: EPEdit通过零样本学习策略消除了微调成本，结合简洁的交互方式，为不具备专业技能的用户提供了高效、低成本的图像编辑工具，在多种编辑任务上超越了现有方案。

title: Navigating User Behavior toward Personalized Multimodal Generation
comment: 16 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen
summary: Modern AIGC pipelines deliver high-fidelity images and videos but presuppose a well-formed creation instruction, while end users rarely articulate visual details, leaving generators misaligned with user demand. We study personalized content generation, which turns a user's interaction history into an executable instruction for downstream synthesis, and identify two obstacles: behavior must be encoded in a form legible to language reasoning, and the model must acquire instruction-writing skill absent from both pretraining and behavior data. We propose NaviGen, which represents each item with a dual identifier coupling a collaborative code and a textual code as a behavioral substrate and a semantic bridge in one token stream. On this representation, a two-stage SFT+RL pipeline first distills preference reasoning and instruction writing from evolutionarily searched supervision, then aligns generation with user intent through hierarchical and self-consistent rewards. Experiments across product, game, and short-video domains show that NaviGen improves personalized image and video generation, strengthens next-item prediction, and yields more specific, relevant, and visually generatable instructions. Our code is anonymously released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen.

AI.tldr: NaviGen通过双重标识符编码用户行为，结合SFT+RL两阶段训练，实现个性化内容生成，在商品、游戏、短视频领域提升图像/视频生成质量与指令准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC管线假设用户能给出完善的创建指令，但实际用户很少描述视觉细节，导致生成结果与用户需求错位。需要将用户交互历史转化为可执行的生成指令。
AI.method: 提出NaviGen，为每个物品设计双重标识符（协同编码+文本编码），作为行为基座和语义桥梁；采用两阶段SFT+RL流水线，先通过演化搜索监督蒸馏偏好推理和指令写作能力，再通过分层自洽奖励对齐生成与用户意图。
AI.result: 在商品、游戏、短视频三个领域，NaviGen提升了个性化图像/视频生成质量、强化了下一物品预测能力，生成的指令更具体、相关且可直接用于视觉生成。
AI.conclusion: 双重标识符表示结合两阶段训练能有效弥合用户行为与生成指令之间的鸿沟，实现高质量个性化内容生成。

title: Towards Spec Learning: Inference-Time Alignment from Preference Pairs
summary: Steering a large language model (LLM) toward a desired behavior typically relies on an iterative process of hand-crafting a prompt based on a careful inspection of the model's responses. This is an involved, brittle, and error-prone process. Preference-based fine-tuning is a more rigorous but often prohibitively expensive solution. We propose spec learning, a framework that relies on a brief user instruction and a small set of preference judgments. These are compiled into specifications in the form of natural-language prompts for an LLM. Specifications condition LLMs at inference time, and no parameter updates to the underlying models are required. We show that the responses generated based on the compiled specifications often outperform direct preference optimization (DPO) on datasets from specialized domains whose preference signal is dense. Unlike opaque weight updates, the resulting specifications are human-readable and double as interpretable and transparent written embodiments of the preference signal that produced them.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为“规范学习”（spec learning）的框架，通过少量用户指令和偏好判断生成自然语言规范，无需更新模型参数即可在推理时引导大语言模型行为，且效果常优于直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.motivation: 传统的手动设计提示词方法繁琐、脆弱且易出错，而基于偏好的微调虽然更严谨但成本过高，因此需要一种既高效又低成本的方法来引导大语言模型的行为。
AI.method: 将用户的简短指令和小规模偏好判断编译为自然语言形式的规范（specifications），在推理时用这些规范条件化大语言模型，无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在偏好信号密集的专业领域数据集上，基于编译规范生成的响应效果通常优于直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.conclusion: 规范学习生成的规范是可读、可解释且透明的，能够清晰地体现产生它们的偏好信号，避免了不透明的权重更新。

title: VisChronos: Revolutionizing Image Captioning Through Real-Life Events
summary: This paper aims to bridge the semantic gap between visual content and natural language understanding by leveraging historical events in the real world as a source of knowledge for caption generation. We propose VisChronos, a novel framework that utilizes large language models and dense captioning models to identify and describe real-life events from a single input image. Our framework can automatically generate detailed and context-aware event descriptions, enhancing the descriptive quality and contextual relevance of generated captions to address the limitations of traditional methods in capturing contextual narratives. Furthermore, we introduce a new dataset, EventCap (https://zenodo.org/records/14004909), specifically constructed using the proposed framework, designed to enhance the model's ability to identify and understand complex events. The user study demonstrates the efficacy of our solution in generating accurate, coherent, and event-focused descriptions, paving the way for future research in event-centric image understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisChronos框架，利用大语言模型和密集字幕模型从单张图像中识别并描述真实事件，同时构建EventCap数据集，以提升图像描述的语义丰富性和上下文相关性。
AI.motivation: 传统图像描述方法难以捕捉图像中蕴含的上下文叙事和真实世界事件，视觉内容与自然语言理解之间存在语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出VisChronos框架，结合大语言模型和密集字幕模型，从单张输入图像中自动识别和描述真实世界事件，并构建EventCap数据集用于训练和评估。
AI.result: 用户研究证明该方法能生成准确、连贯且聚焦于事件的描述，优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: VisChronos有效弥补了图像描述中事件级语义理解的不足，为事件中心图像理解的研究开辟了新方向。

title: Towards Version-aware Operations and Transaction Memories for Multi-layer MeMo
comment: Accepted by MeMo Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability & Neuro-symbolic Approaches by-design, Rome (Italy), 24/6/2026
summary: MeMo proposes language models with explicit multi-layer correlation matrix memories (CMMs), where memorization, retrieval, and forgetting are architectural operations. This paper asks how such memories can reduce the need for retraining when knowledge changes. For changes expressible as MeMo memory associations, the model's accessible knowledge can be updated by editing explicit memories rather than retraining the whole model. We propose a version-aware operation layer in which high-level operations such as replace, obsolete, keep-history, rollback, and trace are compiled into MeMo-native primitive calls over sequences and tokens. The key observation is that a version-aware operation is rarely a single MeMo association. It is an ordered transaction of primitive edits, for example forgetting one sequence-token chain, memorizing another, preserving a historical chain, and recording an inverse program. The framework introduces two auxiliary CMMs: a Version CMM (V-CMM) for mapping version transitions to transaction handles, and a Transaction CMM (T-CMM) for storing reusable change contents and inverse programs.
