It supports both direct sequence-level edits and structured diff-level inputs, and outlines an evaluation route for update success, rollback, traceability, locality, and transaction reuse.

AI.tldr: MeMo提出一种基于多层相关矩阵记忆（CMM）的语言模型架构，通过显式记忆编辑而非全模型重训练来更新知识，并引入版本感知操作层，支持替换、废弃、回滚等高级操作，通过版本CMM和事务CMM实现细粒度知识事务管理。
AI.motivation: 降低语言模型在知识变化时重新训练的高昂成本，探索通过显式记忆编辑而非全模型重训练来更新知识的可行性。
AI.method: 提出MeMo架构，包含多层相关矩阵记忆（CMM）；设计版本感知操作层，将高级操作编译为针对序列和token的MeMo原生调用；引入辅助CMM：版本CMM（V-CMM）映射版本转换到事务句柄，事务CMM（T-CMM）存储可复用的变更内容和逆程序。
AI.result: 支持直接序列级编辑和结构化diff级输入；提出更新成功、回滚、可追溯性、局部性和事务复用等评估路线。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式记忆编辑而非重训练来更新知识是可行的，版本感知操作层能有效支持复杂知识变更管理。

title: FlowR2A: Learning Reward-to-Action Distribution for Multimodal Driving Planning
summary: Multimodal driving planning faces a long-standing tension between two paradigms: scoring-based methods benefit from dense reward supervision but are confined to a fixed action vocabulary, while anchor-based methods generate proposals dynamically yet suffer from sparse supervision constrained to a single ground-truth trajectory. In this work, we propose FlowR2A, which resolves this tension by reframing simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions. By learning the reward-conditioned action distribution from dense trajectory-reward pairs with a flow-matching decoder, FlowR2A unifies the dense supervision of scoring-based methods with the proposal generation of anchor-based methods in a single generative model, forcing the model to internalize the correlation between an action and its outcomes in safety, progress, comfort, and rule compliance. To balance hard safety constraints against soft progress objectives, we introduce fine-grained per-timestep reward conditioning and reward noise augmentation. The generative formulation naturally supports controllable test-time sampling via reward guidance and anchored sampling, producing high-quality proposals. FlowR2A achieves state-of-the-art results on the NAVSIM v1 and v2 benchmarks, with multimodal proposals of substantially higher quality than prior methods.

AI.tldr: FlowR2A通过将仿真奖励从判别目标重构为生成条件，融合了基于评分和基于锚点两种规划范式的优势，在NAVSIM基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态驾驶规划中基于评分的方法（密集奖励但动作词汇固定）与基于锚点的方法（动态生成但稀疏监督）之间的长期矛盾。
AI.method: 将仿真奖励重构为生成条件，使用流匹配解码器学习奖励条件化的动作分布，引入细粒度逐时间步奖励条件和奖励噪声增强，支持奖励引导和锚点采样的测试时可控采样。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2基准上取得SOTA结果，生成的多模态提案质量显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: FlowR2A通过统一两种范式的优势，使模型内化了动作与其在安全性、进展、舒适性和规则合规性方面结果之间的关联。

title: Best Preprocessing Techniques for Sentiment Analysis
summary: Sentiment analysis in Twitter datasets is important because it enables monitoring public opinion on products and analysis of political and social movements. One critical step is preprocessing: the automated processing of text for machine learning algorithms. Preprocessing plays a critical role in reducing noise and improving efficiency. However, little research has systematically examined the order in which preprocessing techniques are implemented. We find that, when accounting for order, spelling correction is the least impactful preprocessing technique, whereas tokenisation is the most impactful. Stemming and stop-word removal are interchangeable, and it is better to remove stop words without removing negation. The best order for applying the preprocessing techniques was tokenisation, text cleaning, stemming, and then stopword removal. Our results provide a systematic approach for practitioners to deploy preprocessing to improve model output without the costly preprocessing exploratory phase.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Twitter情感分析中预处理技术的执行顺序，发现分词（tokenisation）影响最大，拼写纠正影响最小，并提出了最佳预处理顺序：分词 → 文本清洗 → 词干提取 → 停用词去除（保留否定词）。
AI.motivation: Twitter情感分析中预处理至关重要，但以往研究缺乏对预处理技术执行顺序的系统性考察。
AI.method: 系统比较不同预处理技术的执行顺序对情感分析模型输出的影响。
AI.result: 拼写纠正影响最小，分词影响最大；词干提取和停用词去除可互换；去除停用词时应保留否定词；最佳顺序为：分词、文本清洗、词干提取、停用词去除。
AI.conclusion: 提出了系统化的预处理流程顺序，帮助从业者省去昂贵的预处理探索阶段，直接提升模型效果。

title: ObsGraph: Hierarchical Observation Representation for Embodied Reasoning and Exploration
summary: Embodied reasoning and exploration are increasingly considered crucial abilities for robots operating in complex and unfamiliar environments. To accomplish tasks in such settings, an agent must identify and acquire the information necessary for the task through exploration. We propose ObsGraph, an observation-centric hierarchical scene graph that unifies scene representation, retrieval, and exploration. It retains visual evidence and organizes it into room-view-object layers: rooms provide coarse semantic anchors, views preserve contextual object covisibility, and objects store fine-grained details. On top of this representation, we perform coarse-to-fine hierarchical retrieval under a bounded budget, and crucially use retrieval outcomes to structure the exploration candidate space--activating room-level exploration, view refinement, or frontier exploration--thereby tightly coupling representation, retrieval, and adaptive multi-scale exploration. Experiments across embodied reasoning and exploration benchmarks demonstrate improved success and efficiency, highlighting the benefits of structured scene representation and more targeted information gathering driven by identified evidence gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ObsGraph，一种以观察为中心的层次化场景图，通过统一场景表示、检索和探索，实现机器人在复杂环境中的具身推理与高效信息收集。
AI.motivation: 机器人在复杂陌生环境中需要主动识别并获取任务所需信息，现有方法在场景表示、信息检索与探索策略之间缺乏紧密耦合，导致探索效率低下。
AI.method: 构建ObsGraph层次化场景图（房间-视图-对象三层结构）；在此基础上进行粗到细的分层预算受限检索；利用检索结果动态指导探索候选空间（房间级探索、视图细化、边界探索），实现表示、检索与自适应多尺度探索的紧密耦合。
AI.result: 在具身推理与探索基准测试中，ObsGraph在任务成功率和探索效率上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的场景表示与基于信息缺失驱动的目标化信息收集，能显著提升机器人探索与推理能力。

title: Selective Capability Unlearning in End-to-End Spoken Language Understanding
summary: Modern spoken language understanding (SLU) systems are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, where specific functionalities may need to be removed due to policy or safety constraints. In SLU, a functionality corresponds to an intent and its associated slot-generation behavior. However, in autoregressive models, suppressing a target intent does not eliminate the conditional mapping that generates slots conditioned on that intent. When the intent prefix is externally supplied, the model can reconstruct the original intent-slot structure. We identify this structural failure as \textbf{\emph{capability persistence}}. We propose \textit{\underline{B}inding \underline{S}ubspace (BSU)}, a representation-level framework that isolates and attenuates intent-conditioned directions underlying this mapping. Across SLU benchmarks, BSU substantially reduces forced-prefix recoverability while preserving retained performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自回归SLU模型中移除意图后仍存在“能力持久化”问题（外部提供意图前缀可重建原结构），并提出表征级方法BSU（绑定子空间）来隔离并衰减意图条件方向，显著降低强制前缀可恢复性同时保留保留性能。
AI.motivation: 现有SLU系统在移除特定意图功能时，自回归模型仍能通过外部提供的意图前缀重建原意图-槽结构（即能力持久化问题），需要一种有效的表征级方法来隔离和衰减这种条件映射。
AI.method: 提出绑定子空间（BSU）框架，在表征层面识别并隔离意图条件方向，通过衰减这些方向来阻断意图到槽的条件映射，从而解决能力持久化问题。
AI.result: 在多个SLU基准上，BSU显著降低了强制前缀可恢复性（即无法通过外部意图前缀重建原结构），同时保持了保留任务的性能不受影响。
AI.conclusion: BSU是一种有效的表征级解决方案，能够在保证模型保留性能的同时，解决自回归SLU模型中因意图条件映射导致的“能力持久化”问题。

title: Fabric Image Demoiréing Benchmark from Synthesis to Restoration
summary: Fabric moiré is a sampling-induced aliasing artifact caused by the interaction between fine textile patterns and camera sensor grids, producing structured interference that severely degrades image quality. Unlike screen-induced moiré, which stems from strictly periodic display lattices, fabric moiré is intrinsically more challenging due to the broadband and semi-periodic nature of textile weaves. The heavy spectral overlap between intrinsic texture and aliasing components renders fabric demoiréing substantially more ill-posed. Consequently, existing models trained on screen moiré datasets generalize poorly to these complex textile patterns. Despite its practical importance, fabric image demoiréing remains underexplored and lacks standardized benchmarks. We present the first comprehensive benchmark for fabric image demoiréing. To address the difficulty of acquiring pixel-aligned real-world pairs, we develop a physically motivated synthesis framework and construct a large-scale dataset comprising 16,050 paired multi-resolution fabric images with controllable aliasing severity. Furthermore, we customize a baseline model, which establishes promising performance on the proposed benchmark dataset with strong generalization ability. Our benchmark provides a standardized platform for advancing research in fabric image demoiréing.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次构建了织物图像去摩尔纹的完整基准，包括物理合成框架、大规模数据集和基线模型，解决了织物摩尔纹因宽带半周期特性导致的去摩尔纹难题。
AI.motivation: 织物摩尔纹由精细纺织图案与相机传感器网格相互作用产生，具有宽带和半周期特性，比屏幕摩尔纹更难去除。现有模型在屏幕摩尔纹数据集上训练后对织物图案泛化能力差，而织物图像去摩尔纹领域缺乏标准化基准和数据集。
AI.method: 提出了物理驱动的合成框架，构建了包含16,050张配对多分辨率织物图像的大规模数据集，并定制了基线模型。
AI.result: 提出的数据集包含可控混叠严重程度的多分辨率织物图像，基线模型在该基准上表现出良好的性能和强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为织物图像去摩尔纹研究提供了标准化平台，推动了该领域的发展。

title: Towards Federated Long-Tailed Graph Learning: An Energy-Guided Dual Decoupling Approach
summary: Federated Graph Learning facilitates collaborative graph modeling across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. However, real-world data categories frequently exhibit long-tailed distributions. Such statistical scarcity severely degrades performance in two ways: it biases the global model toward majority classes, and it structurally isolates minority nodes by submerging them in heterophilic, head-dominated neighborhoods. While existing methods attempt topology-agnostic statistical compensations, they often fail under data scarcity. Instead of recovering tail nodes, they overfit the structural noise from adjacent dominant classes, leading to representation degradation. To address these limitations, we propose FedEPD, a framework built on a dual decoupling paradigm that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration. Specifically, FedEPD utilizes distribution-aware Dirichlet energy pruning to filter spatial heterophilic edges. It then overcomes Non-IID distribution shifts by extracting robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes, which are incorporated into local representations via a spatial low-pass prototype injection. Furthermore, a two stage alternating optimization strategy strictly protects majority decision boundaries while improving minority accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedEPD achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-tailed benchmarks, yielding absolute improvements of up to 4.97% in Accuracy and 5.48% in Macro-F1.

AI.tldr: 提出了FedEPD框架，通过拓扑净化与语义重校准的双重解耦范式，解决联邦图学习中的长尾分布问题，在准确率和Macro-F1上分别提升最高4.97%和5.48%。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中的数据类别常呈现长尾分布，导致全局模型偏向多数类，少数类节点被异质性主导的头类邻域所淹没，现有拓扑无关的统计补偿方法在数据稀缺下易过拟合结构噪声。
AI.method: 提出FedEPD框架：1）基于分布感知的Dirichlet能量剪枝过滤异质性边；2）从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒全局原型，通过空间低通原型注入融入局部表示；3）两阶段交替优化策略保护多数类决策边界的同时提升少数类准确率。
AI.result: 在多个长尾基准数据集上达到SOTA，准确率绝对提升最高4.97%，Macro-F1绝对提升最高5.48%。
AI.conclusion: FedEPD通过解耦拓扑净化与语义重校准，有效缓解了长尾分布下的联邦图学习性能退化问题。

title: Sentence-Level Contextual Entrainment in Large Language Models
summary: Contextual entrainment, which is a newly discovered phenomenon in large language models (LLMs), refers to the tendency of a model to assign higher probabilities to tokens that appear in its context. In this work, we extend this phenomenon from the token level to the sentence level by examining the per-token mean log-probability of a sentence instead of the probabilities of individual tokens. We investigate sentence-level contextual entrainment across 26 LLMs from seven families and two datasets, which cover both subjective and objective tasks. We find that sentence-level contextual entrainment exists. This means that the sentences in the prompt (even if they are counterfactual statements) can significantly increase their probability during model inference time. As the model size increases, contextual entrainment gradually decreases. We also find that contextual entrainment is controlled by 2% to 4% of the attention heads. Turning off these attention heads can effectively mitigate contextual entrainment without hurting the model's performance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型中存在句子级上下文牵引现象，即提示中的句子会显著提高其生成概率，该现象受2%-4%的注意力头控制，关闭它们可缓解此现象而不影响模型性能。
AI.motivation: 将上下文牵引现象从token级别扩展至句子级别，探究其在更大语言单元上的表现及影响因素。
AI.method: 通过计算句子每个token的平均对数概率来测量句子级上下文牵引，在26个LLM和两个数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 句子级上下文牵引确实存在，模型越大该现象越弱，约2%-4%的注意力头控制该现象。
AI.conclusion: 关闭控制上下文牵引的注意力头可以在不损害模型性能的情况下有效缓解该现象。

title: End-to-End Radar and Communication Modulation Recognition with Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Although deep learning-based methods can achieve high accuracy in automatic modulation recognition (AMR) tasks, their high computational cost makes it difficult to strike a balance between accuracy and power consumption, thereby limiting their application on resource-constrained platforms. Neuromorphic architectures that perform spike-driven inference with modest energy budgets have recently been explored for vision and timeseries tasks. Motivated by these works, we propose EMRFormer, a novel end-to-end spiking nerural network (SNN) architecture that applies spike-driven transformer to the constraints of neuromorphic hardware for AMR. The model incorporates an adaptive spike encoder and Integer Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neurons to mitigate the degradation of effective information and enhance SNN representational capacity. By integrating spike-separable Convolution Neural Networks (SSCNN) into Spike-Driven Transformers (SpikeFormer), EMRFormer effectively extracts multi-scale temporal features from the raw IQ waveforms. We validate our approach across various mainstream datasets, the experimental results show that EMRFormer achieves state-of-the-art interms of accuracy, outperforming all the baselines. Furthermore, the model maintains strong performance in low signal-to-noise(SNR) environments and reduces theoretical energy consumption by over 90%. Finally, we evaluate our model on a KA200 neuromorphic chip. The results show that our model achieves up to 5 times reduction in power compared to running on a 3090 GPU or an Orin NX. This work demonstrates a promising pathway for AMR on resource-constrained devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMRFormer，一种基于脉冲驱动Transformer的端到端脉冲神经网络架构，用于自动调制识别。该模型在KA200神经形态芯片上相比GPU功耗降低5倍，准确率超越所有基线，理论能耗降低超90%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习方法在自动调制识别任务中虽准确率高，但计算成本高，难以在资源受限平台上实现准确率与功耗的平衡。
AI.method: 提出EMRFormer架构，包含自适应脉冲编码器、整数LIF神经元，并融合脉冲可分离CNN与脉冲驱动Transformer，从原始IQ波形中提取多尺度时间特征。
AI.result: 在多个主流数据集上达到最先进准确率，低信噪比环境下保持强性能，理论能耗降低超90%；在KA200芯片上相比3090 GPU或Orin NX功耗降低5倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为资源受限设备上的自动调制识别提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Probing the Misaligned Thinking Process of Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit a growing range of misaligned behaviors such as strategic deception, sandbagging, and self-preservation. As they are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, it is critical to reliably detect such behaviors to ensure safe and responsible use. In this work, we propose to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes. We develop a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors, paired with an automated, meta-plan-guided pipeline that generates multi-turn training conversations. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we construct an out-of-distribution suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations. Across 5 misaligned behaviors, our probes match a strong LLM judge with 0.935 AUROC on out-of-distribution benchmarks while keeping a low false positive rate on benign traffic. We further perform in-depth analysis to understand the probes and the model's internal representations of misalignment indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过线性探针检测大语言模型内部激活中的18种细粒度认知过程（即“不对齐指标”），以监控模型的不对齐行为。该方法在OOD场景下达到0.935 AUROC，且误报率低。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型表现出策略性欺骗、装傻、自我保存等不对齐行为，且正被部署于高风险场景，因此亟需可靠的方法来检测这些行为，以确保安全与负责任的使用。
AI.method: 将不对齐行为分解为18种细粒度认知指标（不对齐指标），通过自动化元计划引导流程生成多轮训练对话，并利用线性探针从模型内部激活中检测这些指标的存在。
AI.result: 在5种不对齐行为上，该方法在OOD基准测试中达到0.935 AUROC，与强大的LLM评判者相当，且在良性对话上保持低误报率。
AI.conclusion: 基于内部激活的细粒度认知指标检测是一种有效的不对齐监控方法，具有良好的泛化能力和低误报率。

title: CAVEWOMAN: How Large Language Models Behave Under Linguistic Input and Output Compression
summary: "Talk short. Drop grammar. Save token." This caveman style is widely promoted as a way to cut inference cost, but whether it actually saves anything depends on which channel (the user's prompt or the model's response) is being compressed. We present Cavewoman, a two-channel evaluation protocol that scores every generation on task accuracy, realized per-item cost, and reference-text agreement against the model's unconstrained reference. We evaluate eight models on five datasets at five reduction levels, with both channels measured on the same items. Output compression cuts realized cost on most API models (1.4-2.4x per model, up to 3x in the best case) and on all four open-weight models under public-tier pricing. Input compression has the opposite effect, a strict lose-lose: it raises net cost rather than lowering it (~1.15x on the five-benchmark mean, up to 1.8x on the worst dataset and 2.7x under stronger compression), because models compensate with longer responses even as accuracy collapses. Under the same setting, surface text diverges from the unconstrained reference: on the non-reasoning models, roughly half of all generations are correct yet their surface text no longer entails the model's own unconstrained baseline generation. The divergence survives length-controlled re-scoring, multiple-comparisons correction, and replication under complementary semantic measures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/danielle34/cavewoman.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cavewoman评估协议，发现输出压缩能降低推理成本（最高3倍），而输入压缩反而增加成本（最高2.7倍）并导致准确率下降和文本偏离。
AI.motivation: 当前广泛推广的"洞穴人风格"（短句、省略语法）提示压缩方法是否真正节省推理成本存在争议，需要系统评估输入压缩和输出压缩对成本和准确性的实际影响。
AI.method: 提出双通道（输入/输出）评估协议Cavewoman，在5个数据集上对8个模型、5个压缩级别，同时测量任务准确率、实际每个样本成本和与未约束参考文本的一致性。
AI.result: 输出压缩在多数API模型上实现1.4-2.4x成本降低（最佳3x），所有开源模型在公开定价下也有效；输入压缩反而增加成本约1.15x（最高2.7x），且准确率下降；约半数正确生成的文本与未约束基线不一致。
AI.conclusion: 输出压缩是有效的成本节约手段，而输入压缩是双输策略，不仅不省钱反而更贵且质量更差。

title: Tractable Reasoning and Conjunctive Query Answering for Defeasible DL-Lite under Rational Closure
summary: In Description Logics (DLs), reasoning under Rational Closure (RC) is a well-known and widely accepted non-monotonic formalism to handle defeasible knowledge. In this paper, we study the application of RC to the core and horn variants of the DL-Lite family of lightweight description logics. We analyze both entitlement (instance checking) and Conjunctive Query (CQ) answering under RC. Our main contribution is providing a plug-in architecture that builds upon existing standard classical reasoners, establishing that reasoning and CQ answering under RC for DL-Lite can be done efficiently with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了理性闭包（Rational Closure, RC）在DL-Lite系列轻量级描述逻辑的核心和Horn变体中的应用，提出了一个插件架构，利用现有经典推理器高效实现实例检测和合取查询回答，计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 将非单调推理形式——理性闭包（RC）应用于DL-Lite系列轻量级描述逻辑，填补该领域在RC下的实例检测和合取查询回答的研究空白。
AI.method: 提出一种插件架构，在现有标准经典推理器的基础上构建，实现对DL-Lite在RC下的推理和查询回答。
AI.result: 证明了在DL-Lite中，基于RC的推理和合取查询回答可以高效实现，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的插件架构能够有效地将理性闭包引入DL-Lite家族，在保持低计算开销的前提下实现非单调推理和查询回答。

title: Predicting Poets' Origins from Verse: A Computational Analysis of Regional Linguistic Fingerprints in the Complete Tang Poems
summary: We ask whether the geographic origin of Tang-dynasty poets leaves a detectable linguistic trace in their work. Aggregating every poem attributed to each author in the Complete Tang Poems (Quan Tang Shi) and linking poets to their administrative circuit of origin via the China Biographical Database (CBDB), we build a poet-level corpus of 357 poets across the ten Tang circuits and frame origin prediction as multi-class classification. Using character $n$-gram TF-IDF together with interpretable domain features (imagery, season, and allusion), classical and neural models predict a poet's broad region (South vs.\ North) at $0.69$ accuracy, well above the $0.53$ majority baseline, and finer circuit-level origin above chance. Beyond classification, three findings emerge. (i) Linguistic distance between circuits grows with geographic distance (Mantel $r=0.40$, $p\approx0.09$ over nine circuits), evidence of a distance-decay effect in poetic language. (ii) The signal interacts with time: South/North separability is at chance in the High Tang and strongest in the Late Tang, consistent with court-driven homogenization at the empire's height followed by regional divergence. (iii) The model's confident errors are historically meaningful -- in the Early Tang, every misclassification is a southern poet read as northern, reflecting the prestige of the northern court idiom. We further show that, when given the whole corpus through a hierarchical frozen-encoder representation, a classical-Chinese transformer (GuwenBERT) only matches -- not beats -- simple TF-IDF, and that combining them adds nothing, indicating that character $n$-grams already capture the regional signal. Our results position interpretable machine learning as a hypothesis generator for literary history.

AI.tldr: 通过分析《全唐诗》中357位诗人的作品，结合CBDB地理数据，使用字符n-gram TF-IDF和可解释特征，发现唐诗语言中存在可检测的地域信号：南北分类准确率达0.69，地理距离与语言距离呈正相关，地域信号在晚唐最强，早期误判反映北方宫廷语言的主导地位。GuwenBERT并未超越简单TF-IDF。
AI.motivation: 探究唐代诗人的地理起源是否在其诗歌作品中留下可检测的语言痕迹，以及这种地域信号在文学史中的历史意义。
AI.method: 基于《全唐诗》构建357位诗人语料库，通过CBDB关联诗人籍贯（10个道），使用字符n-gram TF-IDF和可解释领域特征（意象、季节、典故）进行多分类预测，对比GuwenBERT和TF-IDF性能。
AI.result: 南北分类准确率0.69（baseline 0.53）；地理距离与语言距离正相关（Mantel r=0.40）；地域信号在晚唐最强、盛唐最弱；早期错误集中表现为南方诗人被误判为北方；GuwenBERT仅匹配TF-IDF性能，二者结合无提升。
AI.conclusion: 可解释机器学习可作为文学史的假设生成工具，字符n-gram足以捕获地域信号，地域语言差异随帝国兴衰而变化。

title: Universal Guideline-Driven Image Clustering via a Hybrid LLM Agent
summary: Unifying image clustering across different clustering scenarios remains challenging due to fundamental gaps among tasks. We introduce a Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent, the first universal framework that bridges these gaps through textual guidelines. To incorporate complex guidelines without task-specific training, we propose Generative Concept Proxy Modeling, which generates guideline-aware embeddings via concept proxy extraction. For scenarios requiring automatic cluster discovery, we introduce LLM Traversal based on Minimum Spanning Tree that selectively applies LLM reasoning for complex semantic judgments. Our method generalizes across diverse clustering scenarios spanning from general to fine-grained categorization, from global to local criteria, and from balanced to long-tail distributions. Our framework consistently outperforms specialized methods across diverse clustering tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出首个通用图像聚类框架Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent，通过文本指南和生成式概念代理建模统一不同聚类场景，并引入基于最小生成树的LLM遍历方法，在多种聚类任务上超越已有专门方法。
AI.motivation: 不同图像聚类场景（如粗粒度/细粒度、全局/局部标准、平衡/长尾分布）之间存在根本性差距，缺乏统一的通用框架。
AI.method: 1) Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent：首个通过文本指南桥接不同聚类场景的通用框架；2) Generative Concept Proxy Modeling (GCPM)：通过概念代理提取生成指南感知的嵌入；3) LLM Traversal based on Minimum Spanning Tree：基于最小生成树的LLM遍历，选择性应用LLM推理处理复杂语义判断。
AI.result: 在从通用到细粒度分类、全局到局部标准、平衡到长尾分布等多种聚类场景中，该方法一致性地超越了专门设计的聚类方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的通用框架能够有效统一不同图像聚类场景，无需针对特定任务进行训练即可融入复杂指南，为图像聚类提供了一种泛化能力强的解决方案。

title: LemonHarness Technical Report
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents are applied to longer tasks, they increasingly modify workspace state across multiple rounds of iteration. However, agents typically observe only tool outputs and log fragments, while the actual state changes occur in the file system. Without explicit workspace boundaries, state-changing operations such as file writes and temporary artifact generation may scatter changes across paths. Over time, these weakly constrained changes accumulate, making states such as modified files difficult to track. This paper presents LemonHarness, an integrated execution framework for long-horizon agents. LemonHarness establishes an explicit execution boundary by constraining state-changing operations within a clearly defined workspace and bringing model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge within a single controlled boundary. State-changing operations, including file writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifact creation, are executed through structured tool interfaces, with execution feedback recorded as observations available to subsequent model decisions. The system also introduces a reusable rule knowledge base, which turns recurring execution rules and acceptance criteria into runtime knowledge. LemonHarness further adds a time-aware execution mechanism that exposes elapsed and remaining budget to the model, so it can rebalance exploration, implementation, and validation effort as time pressure shifts and avoid timeouts from long waits or excessive verification. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX reached 84.49% accuracy over 445 trials; pairing the same framework with the stronger GPT-5.5 backbone raised the average accuracy to 86.52% across five jobs. The results suggest that a unified runtime boundary, callable rule knowledge, and time-aware execution can improve the stability of long-horizon agent execution.

AI.tldr: LemonHarness是一个面向长周期LLM Agent的集成执行框架，通过明确执行边界、结构化工具接口、可复用规则知识库和时序感知执行机制，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到84.49%-86.52%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent在长周期任务中，状态变更操作（文件写入、临时生成等）缺乏明确的工作空间边界，导致路径散乱、状态难以追踪，影响执行稳定性和可观测性。
AI.method: 1) 建立显式执行边界，约束状态变更操作在定义清晰的工作空间内；2) 通过结构化工具接口执行文件写入、依赖安装、临时创建等操作，并将执行反馈记录为观测供后续模型决策；3) 引入可复用规则知识库，将执行规则和验收标准转化为运行时知识；4) 添加时序感知执行机制，暴露已用和剩余预算给模型，辅助其平衡探索、实现和验证的时间分配。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX在445次试验中达到84.49%准确率；搭配更强的GPT-5.5骨干网络后，平均准确率提升至86.52%。
AI.conclusion: 统一运行时边界、可调用的规则知识库和时序感知执行机制能够有效提升长周期Agent执行的稳定性。

title: Metis: Bridging Text and Code Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve over time by distilling experience from past executions and reusing it in future tasks. Existing systems represent such experience either as natural-language text injected into the agent context or as code exposed as callable tools. However, the choice between these representations is typically made at design time rather than derived from the characteristics of the experience itself, leaving the trade-offs between them poorly understood. We present the first controlled study that isolates text memory and code memory over an identical set of experiences. Our results show that the two forms exhibit complementary trade-offs in construction cost, execution efficiency, and transferability, such that neither representation alone is sufficient. Guided by these findings, we propose Metis, a self-evolving agent system built on a hierarchical dual-representation memory. Metis organizes textual experience into execution plans, environment facts, and common pitfalls, and selectively crystallizes recurring plans into validated callable tools. This design combines the broad applicability of text memory with the execution efficiency of code memory while incurring tool-generation cost only when justified by repeated reuse. We evaluate Metis on AppWorld, a challenging benchmark for interactive agents. The results show that Metis improves task accuracy by up to 20.6% over ReAct while reducing execution cost by up to 22.8%. Compared with representative self-evolving agent systems, Metis consistently achieves a better balance between accuracy, execution efficiency, and memory-construction cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Metis，一种基于层次化双表示记忆的自进化智能体系统。通过对比文本记忆和代码记忆的互补性权衡，Metis将经验组织为执行计划、环境事实和常见陷阱，并选择性将重复计划固化为可调用工具。在AppWorld基准上，Metis相比ReAct提升准确率20.6%，降低执行成本22.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体系统对经验的表示（文本或代码）通常在设计时选定，而非根据经验特征推导，导致两种表示的权衡尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 提出Metis系统，采用层次化双表示记忆：文本记忆组织为执行计划、环境事实和常见陷阱；代码记忆将重复出现的计划选择性固化为可调用的已验证工具。通过受控实验对比两种记忆形式的构建成本、执行效率和可迁移性。
AI.result: 在AppWorld基准上，Metis相比ReAct提升任务准确率20.6%，降低执行成本22.8%。相比其他自进化系统，在准确率、执行效率和记忆构建成本之间取得更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 文本记忆和代码记忆具有互补性权衡，单独使用任一表示都不足以最优。Metis的双表示设计结合了两者优势，仅在重复使用时才产生工具生成成本，实现了更高效的自进化智能体系统。

title: DramaDirector: Geometry-Guided Short Drama Generation
comment: 20 pages, 17 figures, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/DramaDirector
summary: Short dramas, with their rapid shot rhythms, dialogue-driven focus shifts, and demanding cinematographic grounding, pose challenges that prompt-level or text-only video generation pipelines struggle to meet. We study plot-to-short-drama generation, where a global plot and local context are transformed into visually grounded multi-shot videos. We propose DramaDirector, a geometry-grounded framework that lets the planner borrow cinematographic geometry from a gallery of real short-drama shots indexed by depth and pose. DramaDirector decouples each shot into static visual and dynamic narrative conditions, trains the planner with schema-constrained SFT and GRPO under a learned text-visual alignment reward, and retrieves depth-pose references to guide first-frame generation and image-to-video synthesis. We also introduce DramaBoard, a benchmark built from 35 live-action dramas, 2.8K episodes, and 81K shots, with structured storyboards and multi-dimensional evaluation protocols. Experiments show that DramaDirector improves over representative multi-agent and video generation baselines on faithfulness, consistency, and controllability. Our code is released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/DramaDirector

AI.tldr: 本文提出DramaDirector框架，利用几何约束（深度和姿态）从真实短剧镜头库中检索参考，结合模式约束的SFT和GRPO训练，实现从剧情到多镜头短剧的视频生成，并在自建DramaBoard基准上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 短剧的快速镜头切换、对话驱动的焦点转移和苛刻的摄影基础挑战，使得现有提示级或纯文本视频生成管道难以胜任。
AI.method: 提出DramaDirector框架，从真实短剧镜头库中按深度和姿态索引检索摄影几何参考；将每个镜头解耦为静态视觉和动态叙事条件；采用模式约束的SFT和GRPO结合文本-视觉对齐奖励训练规划器；利用检索到的深度-姿态参考引导首帧生成和图像到视频合成。同时构建了包含35部真人剧、2.8K集、81K镜头的DramaBoard基准。
AI.result: 实验表明DramaDirector在忠实度、一致性和可控性上优于代表性多智能体和视频生成基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于几何约束的镜头引导方法能够有效提升短剧视频生成的质量，为剧情到多镜头视频生成提供了可行方案。

title: MVG-KAN: Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN for PM$_{2.5}$ Forecasting
summary: Accurate short-term PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting is important for public health protection, air-quality early warning, and urban environmental management. However, PM$_{2.5}$ variation is driven by multiple coupled factors, including stable periodic changes induced by human activities and meteorological regularity, station-specific short-term concentration evolution, and meteorology-driven pollutant dispersion among monitoring stations. Existing spatio-temporal forecasting methods may capture station relationships to some extent, but distance-only, correlation-based, or purely adaptive graphs are often insufficient to comprehensively represent these heterogeneous factors, especially wind-direction-dependent pollutant transport. To address this problem, we propose a Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN model for PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting, named \textbf{MVG-KAN}, which models station-level PM$_{2.5}$ evolution from three complementary views: local periodic regularity, station-wise residual temporal dynamics, and meteorological-environment-guided spatial dispersion. Specifically, the periodic-residual forecasting backbone first separates stable daily and weekly patterns from non-periodic residual variations. A Geo-Wind Graph is constructed by combining geographic distance decay with wind-direction- and wind-speed-aware transport, providing a lightweight physically motivated directed spatial prior for residual propagation among stations. In addition, a temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold network (TKAN) residual head is then introduced to learn station-wise nonlinear autoregressive correction from de-periodized PM$_{2.5}$ residuals and historical multi-pollutant sequences, thereby enhancing the modeling of local residual inertia and pollutant co-variation.

AI.tldr: 提出MVG-KAN模型，通过局部周期性、站点残差动态和气象引导的空间扩散三个视角，结合地理-风向导图和时序KAN网络，实现更准确的PM2.5短期预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法难以全面刻画PM2.5变化中的多耦合因素（周期性、站点残差演化、风向依赖的污染物传输），尤其缺乏对风向导引的污染物扩散的有效建模。
AI.method: 1) 周期-残差分解骨干分离日/周模式与残差；2) 地理-风向导图结合距离衰减和风向风速感知的污染物传输；3) 时序KAN残差头对去周期化残差进行非线性自回归校正。
AI.result: 该方法通过多视图融合提升了PM2.5预测精度，特别是在风向依赖的污染物传输建模方面优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: MVG-KAN通过周期-残差分解、物理引导图结构和KAN时序建模的综合方案，有效解决了多因素耦合下的PM2.5预测问题。

title: Accelerating Disaggregated RL for Visual Generative LLMs with Diffusion-Based Parallelism and Trainer-Assisted Generation
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, driving the emergence of high-performance RL systems such as veRL for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). In parallel, diffusion-oriented RL algorithms, e.g., DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, have rapidly expanded the scope of RL from language reasoning to diffusion-based visual and flow-based generation. However, efficient RL systems for diffusion generative LLMs remain underexplored. Existing implementations, e.g., veRL-Omni, still rely on colocated execution, which simplifies synchronization but couples rollout and training resources, limits heterogeneous deployment, and constrains independent scaling.
  To this end, we introduce DigenRL, a disaggregated RL framework for diffusion-based generative LLMs that supports flexible resource allocation, accommodates heterogeneous GPUs, and facilitates efficient task scheduling. To maximally reduce the execution bubbles in the disaggregated architecture, we propose: 1) a generation-axis pipeline (GAP) and time-step parallelism (TSP) in the diffusion architecture to enable finer-grained pipelining between rollout and training; 2) an elastic trainer-assisted generation (TAG) approach to enable the trainer GPU resources to dynamically assist in executing rollout generations; and 3) a tightly one-step constrained asynchronous strategy to further utilize the tail bubble in the pipeline. Extensive experiments are conducted on three hardware testbeds with 16-32 GPUs using HunyuanVideo-13B, Wan2.1-14B, FLUX.1-12B, and QwenImage-20B generative models. Experimental results show that DigenRL achieves 1.56-2.10x throughput improvements over state-of-the-art diffusion RL systems, veRL-Omni and GenRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DigenRL，一种用于扩散生成式大语言模型的解耦强化学习框架，通过生成轴流水线(GAP)、时间步并行(TSP)、弹性训练器辅助生成(TAG)及紧一步约束异步策略，在16-32 GPU测试中实现1.56-2.10x吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散生成式LLM的RL系统（如veRL-Omni）仍依赖共置执行，限制了异构部署和独立扩展。高效RL系统在扩散生成式LLM中尚待探索。
AI.method: 提出解耦RL框架DigenRL，包含：1) 生成轴流水线(GAP)和时间步并行(TSP)实现细粒度流水线；2) 弹性训练器辅助生成(TAG)动态利用训练GPU资源辅助生成；3) 紧一步约束异步策略利用流水线尾部气泡。
AI.result: 在16-32 GPU上使用HunyuanVideo-13B等四个模型测试，相比veRL-Omni和GenRL，吞吐量提升1.56-2.10倍。
AI.conclusion: DigenRL通过解耦架构和多项优化技术，有效提升了扩散生成式LLM的RL训练效率，支持异构GPU灵活调度。

title: BehaviorBench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Behavioral Science Tasks
summary: Foundation models have been increasingly applied to behavioral science domains such as psychology, sociology, and economics. While these models show promise in individual tasks such as survey response prediction and human-subject experiment simulation, there remains no systematic understanding of how well they perform across diverse behavioral science tasks, contexts, and populations. We introduce BehaviorBench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates foundation models along four core capabilities: (1) behavior prediction and simulation, (2) strategic decision-making, (3) subject-trait inference, and (4) behavioral knowledge application. Crucially, BehaviorBench evaluates model outputs at both the individual and distributional levels, capturing not only per-subject accuracy but also population-level alignment, an essential requirement for behavioral validity. Leveraging the tasks in BehaviorBench, we further develop Be.FM-1.5, extending the Be.FM family of behavioral foundation models fine-tuned on behavioral data. Our results reveal a considerable gap: proprietary general-purpose models excel at individual-level prediction and knowledge-intensive tasks, whereas behavioral foundation models, fine-tuned on behavioral data, achieve substantially stronger distributional alignment. Notably, Be.FM-1.5 leads on distributional metrics and remains competitive on individual-level metrics, suggesting that proper behavioral adaptation can close the gap. Our results highlight the importance of distributional evaluation, establish BehaviorBench as a foundation for developing and assessing behaviorally aligned AI systems, and demonstrate Be.FM-1.5's potential for a broad range of behavioral science studies. Our BehaviorBench and Be.FM-1.5 models can be accessed via https://umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BehaviorBench基准，用于评估基础模型在行为科学领域的四项核心能力，并开发了Be.FM-1.5模型。结果显示：通用模型在个体级预测和知识密集型任务上表现优异，而行为基础模型在分布级对齐上更强，Be.FM-1.5在分布指标上领先且个体指标上有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 目前基础模型在行为科学（心理学、社会学、经济学）中的应用日益增多，但缺乏一个系统性基准来评估其在多样化任务、情境和人群中的表现。
AI.method: 构建BehaviorBench基准，评估基础模型在行为预测与模拟、战略决策、主体特质推断和行为知识应用四项能力，并在个体和分布两个层面进行评估。同时开发了Be.FM-1.5行为基础模型。
AI.result: 通用模型在个体级预测和知识密集型任务上表现更好，而行为基础模型在分布级对齐上更强。Be.FM-1.5在分布指标上领先，个体指标上也有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 强调了分布级评估的重要性，BehaviorBench可作为开发行为对齐AI系统的基础，Be.FM-1.5在行为科学研究中具有广阔潜力。

title: An LMM for Precisely Grounding Elements in Documents
summary: Visual grounding in documents is a crucial ability for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in areas such as document understanding, deep research and document error detection. However, existing approaches exhibit poor grounding precision in text-rich document images, often failing to accurately locate the critical document elements needed for reliable reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce PreciseDoc, an LMM specifically designed for precise element grounding and can be further optimized for Document VQA tasks. Specifically, to enhance the basic localization capability, we construct challenging training data by two pipelines capable of mass-producing high-quality documents with paired metadata of fine-grained coordinates, including synthetic hand-filled documents with camera effects. The model develops more real-world functions beyond straightforward localization of single text, such as locating personal information from CVs. Furthermore, we introduce a training paradigm for visual grounded reasoning where the grounding and reasoning are supervised jointly with reinforcement learning to improve the contribution of the grounded evidence. A comprehensive evaluation on various benchmarks demonstrates the advantage of the proposed data and methods in document spatial grounding and document understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PreciseDoc模型，通过构建高质量合成数据（含手写文档及相机效果）和联合强化学习训练范式，显著提升大语言模型在文档图像中的精准定位与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在文本丰富的文档图像中定位精度差，难以准确找到关键文档元素进行可靠推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建两套数据生成管道，可大规模生产带细粒度坐标标注的高质量文档（包括含相机效果的合成手写文档）；2) 提出视觉定位推理训练范式，通过强化学习联合监督定位与推理过程。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的综合评估显示，该方法在文档空间定位和文档理解方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PreciseDoc能精准定位文档元素（如从简历中定位个人信息），并显著提升文档VQA等下游任务的性能。

title: A Pāninian Foundation for Indic Language Processing
summary: More than a billion people communicate in Indic languages, yet the natural language processing infrastructure serving them remains fragmented and underdeveloped. The cause is structural: the field organizes its tools and benchmarks around individual languages or small subsets of genealogical language families, building separate analyzers, parsers, and datasets for each language and starting over for the next. This overlooks a deep regularity. Through more than two millennia of convergence around Sanskrit, Indic languages came to share a morphosyntactic architecture formalized in Pānini's grammar, the Astādhyāyī. This cuts across genealogical lines, uniting languages through a common framework. We argue that this Pāninian framework supplies a unifying computational architecture the field has lacked, and that benchmarks grounded explicitly in it would make Indic language systems more accurate, more data-efficient, and more transferable, effectively merging many apparently disparate and sparse Indic language resources into a single high-resource metalanguage bedrock. We propose a four-part benchmark suite to render this shared architecture explicit, measurable, and ready to be leveraged for practical applications. Moreover, we underscore the question it raises for interpretability research: whether neural models trained on these languages come to represent Pānini's categories on their own.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于波你尼语法框架（Astādhyāyī）的统一计算架构，用于解决印度诸语言NLP资源碎片化问题，并设计四维度基准测试套件来评估和利用这一共享的形态句法体系。
AI.motivation: 超过十亿人使用印度语言，但现有NLP工具按单个语言或语系小分支分别开发，导致资源碎片化且发展不均。论文发现印度语言因两千多年围绕梵语的趋同演化，共享一套由波你尼《八章书》形式化描述的形态句法架构，这一跨谱系的统一框架尚未被计算语言学有效利用。
AI.method: 提出四部分基准测试套件，使波你尼框架显式化、可衡量，并可用于实际应用；同时提出一个可解释性研究问题：神经模型是否自发学习表征波你尼的语法范畴。
AI.result: 预期该框架能使印度语言系统的准确性、数据效率、迁移性显著提升，将分散的低资源印度语言数据整合为单一高资源元语言基础。
AI.conclusion: 波你尼语法框架为印度语言NLP提供了缺失的统一计算架构，基于此的基准测试能推动实际应用发展，并为神经模型的可解释性研究开辟新方向。

title: Flood Mapping from RGB imagery using a Vision Foundation Model
summary: Timely, high-resolution maps of flood extent around settlements are essential for emergency response and damage assessment. We consider airborne RGB imagery for flood mapping as it can be collected rapidly at low cost. To produce flood maps, deep learning models for water segmentation are often used. CNN based and small vision transformer models are used. However, they need much data for adaptation to a change of scenery, i.e., another flooding event. Vision foundation models or large vision transformers are known to generalize across domains. Recently, foundation models for Earth observation became available. They are pretrained on satellite data, whose spatial resolution, viewing geometry, and radiometry differ from nadir RGB imagery. Thus, adaptation is required. We investigate how a satellite-pretrained Earth observation foundation model can be adapted to centimeter-scale floodwater mapping from RGB imagery. Specifically, we fine-tune a model we call Prithvi-2.0-UPN consisting of the Prithvi-EO-2.0-600M Vision Transformer combined with a UPerNet decoder for binary water segmentation on two RGB datasets (BlessemFlood21, NeuenahrFlood). In a first experiment we observe that Prithvi-2.0-UPN reaches state-of-the-art results on BlessemFlood21 and NeuenahrFlood, when trained on their datasets. In a second experiment we show that Prithvi-2.0-UPN performs better than state-of-the-art baseline models for transfer to a new flood event (trained on BlessemFlood21, tested on NeuenahrFlood) in a zero-shot setting. However, the performance indicates room for improvement. In this respect, we investigate in a third experiment how performance improves when further fine-tuning the models with small shares of NeuenahrFlood training data: Prithvi-2.0-UPN improves the fastest and reaches almost the performance level when fully trained on NeuenahrFlood, indicating transfer capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将卫星预训练的地球观测基础模型（Prithvi-EO-2.0-600M + UPerNet）适配到厘米级RGB航空影像的洪水分割任务中，通过在两个洪水数据集上微调，发现该模型在域内训练达到SOTA，在零样本迁移和新数据少量微调场景下均优于基线模型，展现出良好的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 洪水应急响应和灾害评估需要及时、高分辨率的洪水范围地图，而航空RGB影像成本低、采集快。现有深度学习模型（CNN和小型ViT）在场景切换（不同洪水事件）时需要大量标注数据重新训练，泛化能力不足，因此需要研究如何利用预训练的地球观测基础模型来实现跨域迁移。
AI.method: 采用Prithvi-EO-2.0-600M视觉基础模型（大型ViT）搭配UPerNet解码器，构成Prithvi-2.0-UPN，在BlessemFlood21和NeuenahrFlood两个RGB洪水数据集上进行二值水体分割微调。设计了三个实验：域内训练、零样本跨域迁移、以及少量数据继续微调。
AI.result: 1) 域内训练时在两个数据集上均达到SOTA；2) 零样本迁移（Blessem→Neuenahr）优于基线模型；3) 少量Neuenahr数据微调后性能提升最快，接近全量训练水平，表明模型具有良好迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 卫星预训练的地球观测基础模型可以有效适配到航空RGB影像的洪水分割任务，在跨域场景下展现出优于传统模型的迁移学习能力，少量数据微调即可达到接近全量训练的性能，但仍存在改进空间。

title: PHANTOM: A Large-Scale Dataset of Multimodal Adversarial Attacks for Vision-Language Models
comment: The dataset has been released at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/it4lia/PHANTOM
summary: We introduce a large-scale, open-source dataset of pre-generated adversarial attacks for vision-language models (VLMs). The dataset is designed to be diverse, representative, and practical, extending existing benchmarks by covering 10 high-level categories and 55 subcategories of harmful intents. Our primary goal is to make adversarial data accessible to the research community, given the computational cost and complexity of generating large numbers of attacks. The dataset comprises 47 524 adversarial samples, generated using state-of-the-art attack strategies from recent literature. Our work complements existing efforts by consolidating and extending prior benchmarks from multiple established sources, resulting in 7 826 intents, and introduce an additional category to broaden coverage. This provides realistic evaluation resources for studying model robustness and alignment. Our dataset intends to enable researchers and practitioners to systematically evaluate the robustness and safety of VLMs, fine-tune attack-generation models, and develop or stress-test defensive guardrails under diverse adversarial conditions. By releasing this resource, we aim to lower the barrier to adversarial research and foster more reproducible, comprehensive, and comparable evaluations of VLM safety.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个大规模、开源的视觉语言模型对抗攻击数据集，包含47,524个对抗样本，覆盖10个大类和55个子类有害意图，旨在降低对抗性研究门槛，促进VLM安全评估的可复现性和可比性。
AI.motivation: 由于生成大量对抗攻击样本的计算成本和复杂性很高，现有基准测试覆盖不足，研究者难以获取多样化的对抗数据。本文旨在通过提供开放数据集，使对抗性研究更易获取，推动VLM鲁棒性和安全性的系统评估。
AI.method: 从多个现有基准测试中整合并拓展出7,826个意图，使用最新的攻击策略生成47,524个对抗样本，覆盖10个高层类别和55个子类有害意图，并引入额外类别以拓宽覆盖范围。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含47,524个对抗样本的大规模开源数据集，涵盖10个高层类别和55个子类，以及7,826个意图，扩展了现有基准测试的覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集降低了对抗性研究门槛，使研究者能够系统评估VLM的鲁棒性和安全性，微调攻击生成模型，并在多样对抗条件下测试防御机制，促进更可复现、全面和可比的VLM安全评估。

title: A Synthetic Reliability-Aware PINN Benchmark for Offshore Wind Turbine Support-Structure Monitoring with Bayesian Inverse Identification
summary: Reliable structural health monitoring (SHM) of offshore wind turbine (OWT) support structures requires fast state estimation from sparse measurements. Repeated high fidelity finite element or aeroelastic analyses are difficult to use directly in online monitoring loops, while purely data-driven surrogates can require large training sets. This paper presents Digi Turbine, a synthetic reliability-aware Physics Informed Neural Network (PINN) benchmark for OWT monopile support structure monitoring. The workflow embeds a simplified Euler Bernoulli beam equation with Winkler soil foundation in the training objective, couples it with Bayesian-prior-informed inverse identification, and adds First Order Reliability Method (FORM) screening. All validation uses synthetic configurations with analytical or finite-difference ground truth motivated by the NREL 5MW reference turbine context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Digi Turbine，一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的合成基准，用于海上风机单桩支撑结构的结构健康监测，通过嵌入欧拉-伯努利梁方程、贝叶斯先验反演识别和FORM筛选实现快速状态估计。
AI.motivation: 海上风机支撑结构的可靠健康监测需要从稀疏测量中快速估计状态，而传统高保真有限元或气弹分析难以直接用于在线监测，纯数据驱动代理又需要大量训练数据。
AI.method: 将简化的欧拉-伯努利梁方程与Winkler土基础嵌入训练目标，结合贝叶斯先验反演识别和FORM可靠性筛选，所有验证使用NREL 5MW参考风机背景下的合成配置。
AI.result: 在合成配置下，以解析解或有限差分解为基准验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Digi Turbine为OWT单桩支撑结构监测提供了一种可靠的PINN基准方法，平衡了物理建模与数据驱动需求。

title: Bengal-HP_RU: A Dataset of Bengal People For Head Pose Estimation
summary: Existing head pose datasets predominantly feature subjects of Western or East Asian origin, leaving South Asian populations, particularly Bengali individuals, largely underrepresented. We introduce Bengal-HP_RU, the first publicly available head pose dataset centred on Bengali subjects, comprising 12,894 labelled head images annotated with continuous yaw, pitch, and roll values. Images were collected from Wikimedia Commons under free licences and processed through an automated pipeline followed by manual label correction. The dataset is partitioned by Wikimedia uploader identity to prevent data contamination, yielding 10,494 training and 2,400 test images across 296 unique uploaders. Bengal-HP_RU exhibits substantial diversity in subject age, gender, occlusion, illumination, and background, reflecting realistic in-the-wild conditions. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.17632/xbw9kr37jb.2.

AI.tldr: 首个面向孟加拉人群体的公开头部姿态数据集Bengal-HP_RU，包含12,894张标注了连续偏航、俯仰和滚转角度的头部图像，来自296个维基百科上传者，具有年龄、性别、遮挡、光照和背景多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有头部姿态数据集主要涵盖西方或东亚人群，南亚人群（尤其是孟加拉个体）严重缺乏代表性。
AI.method: 从Wikimedia Commons收集图像，经自动化管道处理后再进行人工标签修正，按上传者身份划分数据集以避免数据污染。
AI.result: 构建了10,494张训练图像和2,400张测试图像，覆盖296个不同上传者，数据在年龄、性别、遮挡、光照和背景方面具有显著多样性。
AI.conclusion: Bengal-HP_RU填补了孟加拉人群头部姿态数据的空白，为相关研究提供了公开可用的资源。

title: Age of LLM: A Strategic 1v1 Benchmark for Reasoning, Diplomacy and Reliability of Large Language Models under Fog of War
comment: 25 pages including appendices, 8 figures, 4 tables; appendices include verbatim system prompt and engine resolution pseudocode. All correlations reported with p-values, 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and Spearman's rho; includes a Steiger test and Bradley-Terry fit
summary: We introduce Age of LLM, a turn-based 1v1 benchmark in which two LLMs face off on a 13x7 grid to destroy the enemy base. Three stressors are deliberate: fog of war, full diplomacy (messages, ceasefires, ultimatums; uranium kept secret), and a reliability dimension where every turn must follow a strict JSON schema and an illegal action is silently discarded. The engine is private and each match uses a fresh random map seed and opponent, mitigating the data contamination that affects public benchmarks. Models receive a (near) rule-only prompt with no build-order advice (two tactical seed phrases were present during data collection; see Section 2.7). We benchmark 15 reasoning models across 54 matches and 5,258 actions. Findings: (1) the nuclear rush dominates (78% on the rules-coherent v0.11+ sub-corpus; 85% corpus-wide) with a sole-launcher signature that is largely mechanical under secret-simultaneous launch rules, not a cognitive deterrence failure; (2) military conquest is rare but faster (12.3 vs 18.9 turns); (3) diplomacy is prolific yet almost never consummated; (4) ~58% of illegal actions are fog/state errors, making the illegal-action rate a measure of belief-tracking; (5) -- the least established, and the only one we label exploratory -- a weak link associates reliability with winning. The corpus is small, unbalanced and not side-swapped, so the ranking is a preliminary descriptive view, not a contribution. Beyond ranking, the turn-by-turn traces of actions and messages make the corpus a lens on how LLMs reason under adversarial uncertainty -- their belief-tracking, spontaneous deception, and per-model cognitive "personas" -- which we frame as a future research direction. We release the replay format, an isometric viewer and all replays; engine source on request.

AI.tldr: 提出Age of LLM基准，让15个推理模型在13x7网格上进行1v1对战，发现核rush主导战术（85%）、外交频繁但无实质性合作、非法行动反映信念追踪能力，并初步观察到可靠性高与胜率之间的弱关联。
AI.motivation: 现有公共基准存在数据污染问题，且缺乏能同时测试LLM在对抗性不确定性下的推理、外交、规则遵循和战略规划的综合评估方法。
AI.method: 设计格点战争游戏（13x7），引入战争迷雾、完全外交（消息/停火/最后通牒/秘密铀）、严格JSON格式规则约束等三大压力源；使用私密引擎+随机地图种子+随机对手缓解数据污染；对15个推理模型进行54场对局（5,258个动作）的基准测试。
AI.result: 核rush占主导（规则一致子集78%，全集85%）；军事征服罕见但更快（12.3 vs 18.9回合）；外交频繁但几乎从不达成；~58%非法动作为迷雾/状态错误；初步发现可靠性（低非法动作率）与胜率存在弱关联。
AI.conclusion: Age of LLM为研究LLM在对抗性不确定性下的信念追踪、自发欺骗和认知"人格"提供了新视角；回放数据和查看器已开源，但数据集较小且未交换阵营，排名仅为初步描述性结果。

title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Evolution and its Correlation with Review Rounds in Multi-Round Peer Reviews: A Deep Learning Approach
summary: Mining sentiment information from the textual content of peer review comments offers valuable insights into the scientific evaluation process. However, previous studies are often constrained by coarse-grained analysis and the lack of differentiation across review rounds. Notably, the dynamic shifts in reviewers' focus and sentiment tendencies throughout multiple review stages remain underexplored. To address this gap, the present study investigates the distribution and evolution of aspect-level sentiments and examines their correlation with the number of review rounds. We begin by segmenting the multi-round review comments of 11,063 accepted papers from Nature Communications and identifying fine-grained review aspect clusters. A manually annotated corpus of approximately 5,000 review sentences is then constructed. Using this dataset, we train a series of deep learning-based aspect sentiment classification models. Among them, the LCF-BERT-CDM model achieves the best performance, with a Macro-F1 score of 82.65%. Subsequent statistical analysis reveals a consistent trend: as the number of review rounds increases, the proportion of positive sentiments rises, while negative sentiments decline. Correlation analysis further indicates that aspect sentiment scores are negatively associated with the total number of review rounds. Key aspects exhibiting stronger correlations include "experiments", "research significance" and "result analysis".

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Nature Communications上11,063篇已接收论文的多轮审稿意见，通过构建约5000句人工标注语料库和深度学习模型（LCF-BERT-CDM最优，Macro-F1达82.65%），发现随着审稿轮次增加，正面情感比例上升、负面情感下降，且方面情感得分与审稿轮次总数呈负相关，其中“实验”、“研究意义”和“结果分析”等关键方面相关性更强。
AI.motivation: 以往研究对同行评审意见的情感分析多为粗粒度，且未区分不同审稿轮次。审稿人在多轮评审中的关注点和情感倾向动态变化尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 对11,063篇Nature Communications已接收论文的多轮审稿意见进行分割和细粒度审稿方面聚类；2) 构建约5000句人工标注语料库；3) 训练多种基于深度学习的方面情感分类模型，其中LCF-BERT-CDM表现最优。
AI.result: LCF-BERT-CDM模型Macro-F1达82.65%。统计发现：随着审稿轮次增加，正面情感比例上升，负面情感下降；方面情感得分与审稿轮次总数呈负相关，“实验”、“研究意义”和“结果分析”等关键方面相关性更强。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了多轮同行评审中方面级情感的动态演化规律，证明细粒度情感分析能有效捕捉审稿过程的情感变化趋势，为理解科学评估过程提供了量化视角。

title: Sat2City v2: Native 3D City Asset Generation from a Single Satellite Image
summary: Generating explicit 3D city assets from a single satellite image is important for digital twins, urban simulation, and geospatial intelligence. Unlike satellite-to-street-view synthesis, the task requires a reusable textured mesh with plausible geometry and controllable appearance rather than a 3D proxy optimized only for rendering a small set of images or videos. The ICCV Sat2City framework made a first step by conditioning cascaded sparse-voxel latent diffusion on satellite-derived height maps, but its appearance was random, its training data were synthetic, and its task-specific VAE did not scale well to noisy real-world reconstructions. We present Sat2City v2, a journal extension that adapts a pretrained native structured-latent 3D foundation model to weakly aligned satellite images and textured meshes. We build a real-world dataset with 16,241 satellite-mesh pairs across 24 regions in 9 cities. Instead of learning a 3D representation from noisy city meshes, Sat2City v2 encodes each mesh into a pretrained native 3D latent space, fine-tunes a satellite-conditioned geometry flow, and uses the decoded shape to anchor satellite-conditioned texturing. This retains Sat2City's geometry-to-appearance cascade while enabling appearance-controllable generation from the satellite input. Experiments on metric-scale DSM reconstruction and generative city-asset benchmarks for geometry and appearance show that Sat2City v2 achieves the best overall performance among evaluated baselines. Overall, Sat2City v2 advances satellite-to-city generation from rendering-oriented 3D proxies to explicit textured mesh assets, supported by, to the best of our knowledge, the first documented satellite-mesh paired dataset collected from matched geographic crops for this asset-level task. Project page: https://ai4city-hkust.github.io/Sat2City-v2/

AI.tldr: Sat2City v2 提出了一种从单张卫星图像生成显式3D城市资产的方法，通过预训练的3D基础模型实现几何与外观的可控生成，并构建了首个真实世界的卫星-网格配对数据集（16,241对），在多项基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星到3D城市生成方法存在外观随机、依赖合成数据、任务特定VAE对噪声数据扩展性差等问题，无法生成可复用的显式纹理网格资产。
AI.method: 将城市网格编码到预训练的3D潜在空间，微调卫星条件几何流，用解码形状锚定卫星条件纹理生成，保持几何到外观的级联架构。
AI.result: 在度量尺度DSM重建和生成式城市资产评估中，Sat2City v2在所有基线方法中取得最佳综合性能。
AI.conclusion: Sat2City v2将卫星到城市生成从面向渲染的3D代理推进到显式纹理网格资产，并提供了首个文档化的卫星-网格配对数据集。

title: Geometry-Aware Style Transfer in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: In this paper, we present a novel geometry-aware style transfer framework for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) that simultaneously transfers appearance attributes and geometric structures. Unlike prior works that primarily focus on color-based stylization and often overlook structural adaptation, our method explicitly incorporates geometry adaptation through a decoupled optimization scheme that alternately updates color and geometry parameters. This strategy alleviates potential interference between color and geometry updates, leading to stable and consistent scene-level geometry transformation. The decoupled optimization is enabled by the proposed geometry-aware contrastive feature matching (GCFM). GCFM integrates RGB, depth, and edge cues into a contrastive objective and is employed in both optimization phases to effectively transfer structural characteristics from style images to Gaussian primitives. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves superior performance in both qualitative fidelity and quantitative metrics, significantly outperforming existing 3DGS-based stylization methods. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/oweixx/gast}{https://github.com/oweixx/gast}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向3D高斯泼溅的几何感知风格迁移框架，通过解耦优化策略交替更新颜色与几何参数，并利用几何感知对比特征匹配（GCFM）融合RGB、深度和边缘线索，实现了高质量的外观与几何结构同步迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS风格化方法主要关注颜色风格迁移，忽略了几何结构的适应性调整，导致颜色与几何更新相互干扰，缺乏稳定的场景级几何变换。
AI.method: 提出解耦优化方案，交替更新颜色和几何参数；引入几何感知对比特征匹配（GCFM），将RGB、深度和边缘线索整合到对比学习目标中，在两个优化阶段中迁移结构特征。
AI.result: 在定性保真度和定量指标上均优于现有3DGS风格化方法，表现显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效实现了外观与几何结构的同步风格迁移，为3D场景风格化提供了更稳定、更一致的解决方案。

title: Cycle-Consistent Neural Explanation of Formal Verification Certificates
summary: Formal verification produces machine-checkable certificates that attest to the satisfaction or violation of temporal properties, yet these certificates remain opaque to non-specialist stakeholders. We propose a cycle-consistent neural architecture that generates faithful natural language explanations of verification certificates. A forward network NN1 maps certificates to explanations, and an inverse network NN2 reconstructs certificates from explanations; a symbolic verifier closes the loop, providing a differentiable faithfulness proxy. A pointer-generator mechanism ensures lexical grounding by copying state names directly from the certificate. We evaluate on 420 test certificates spanning six verification methods (bounded proof, k-induction, inductive invariant, lasso, reachability, witness pair) in both YES and NO verdict variants, drawn from a financial compliance domain with 207 named states. Our trained architecture, combined with a hybrid inference-time routing strategy, achieves 90.0% cycle-verified soundness, surpassing a multi- LLM few-shot baseline (76.1% for the best of 16 LLM combinations across four frontier models) by 13.9 percentage points. The neural model wins on 10 of 12 verdict/kind categories, with three categories reaching 100% soundness. The architecture offers 860x faster inference (185 ms vs. 160 s per certificate for the full multi-LLM baseline), offline operation, deterministic outputs, and zero per-inference cost. These results demonstrate that trained specialization outperforms general-purpose LLM prompting for structured certificate explanation, while eliminating the deployment constraints of cloud-based inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种循环一致性神经架构，用于将形式化验证证书转换为自然语言解释。该架构通过前向/反向网络与符号验证器闭环，确保解释的忠实性。在420个测试证书上，该方法在可验证正确性（90.0%）上超过多LLM少样本基线（76.1%），推理速度快860倍，且支持离线运行。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证生成的证书对非专业利益相关者难以理解，需要将机器可验证的证书转换为自然语言解释，同时保证解释的忠实性。
AI.method: 提出循环一致性神经架构：前向网络NN1将证书映射为解释，反向网络NN2从解释重建证书；符号验证器闭环提供可微的忠实性代理；指针生成机制从证书中直接拷贝状态名称以确保词汇基础；混合推理时路由策略选择最优输出。
AI.result: 在420个测试证书上，涵盖6种验证方法、YES/NO两种裁决变体，来自含207个命名状态的金融合规领域。循环验证正确率90.0%，超越多LLM基线（76.1%）13.9个百分点；12个裁决/种类类别中赢10个，3个类别达100%；推理速度860倍优势（185ms vs 160s），支持离线、确定性输出、零推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 专业训练的架构在结构化证书解释任务上优于通用LLM提示方法，同时消除了云端推理的部署约束。

title: Decoherence as Defence and the Magnitude of Noise Regularisation: A Rigorous N -Qubit Theory of Stochastic Quantum Neural Networks for Adversarially Robust Network Intrusion Detection
summary: Stochastic quantum neural networks (SQNNs) encode neuronal activations as qubits, synaptic topology as entanglement, and neural noise through a Lindblad master equation. A recent conference study applied a ring-entangled SQNN to collaborative intrusion detection and reached three conclusions: ring entanglement is \emph{essential} for non-local anomaly detection; an adversarial-resilience bound holds but is \emph{conservative}; and the depolarising channel \emph{fails} to act as a dropout-style regulariser, behaving instead as output noise. It left open whether a per-gate stochastic deactivation (``true quantum dropout'') could regularise where the depolarising channel could not, and whether the loose robustness bound could be replaced by a predictive theory. This paper resolves both and extends the framework to real data and to neutral-atom hardware. We give an $N$-qubit formulation through the stochastic master equation and its vectorised Liouvillian, and prove a \emph{decoherence-contraction theorem}: a depolarising channel of strength $γ$ over $L$ entangling layers contracts every weight-$w$ Pauli read-out by a factor $(1-4γ/3)^{wL}$ (for the weight-$1$ read-out used here, $(1-4γ/3)^{L}$); building on the general noise-as-defence result of Du et al., we make this quantitative and operational for intrusion detection. On the real NSL-KDD dataset under white-box FGSM and PGD attacks, a depolarising SQNN trained with the channel is, over seven seeds under strong $\ell_\infty$/$\ell_2$ attacks, significantly more robust than the noiseless circuit ($\ell_\infty$ PGD-$20$, $p=0.04$, large effect) and, critically, never suffers the catastrophic robustness collapse that the noiseless model and gradient-trained classical detectors (which fall from $95\%$ to $47\%$) do, cutting robustness variance roughly twofold; we show this robustness arises from a noise-reshaped training boundary rather than from attack-time gradient contraction. For generalisation, we derive an adaptive-penalty formula showing that per-gate dropout implements a curvature-weighted $L_2$ penalty $\tfrac{p(1-p)}{2}\sumθ^2\partial^2_θL$ in weight space, maximised at $p=1/2$, whereas depolarising noise implements an output-space penalty. A $30$-seed study confirms the formula's quantitative prediction: both mechanisms reduce the train-test gap by a small but statistically significant margin ($\approx\!0.01$; $p<10^{-4}$ and $p=0.004$), are statistically indistinguishable from each other, and the effect is concentrated where overfitting is largest; increasing the dropout rate past $1/2$ does not help, as the formula predicts. The single-seed dichotomy of prior work does not survive replication. We close with a neutral-atom realisation and a feasibility-by-$N$ analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机量子神经网络（SQNN）的N-qubit形式化框架，证明退极化通道的收缩定理，发现退极化SQNN在真实NSL-KDD数据集上比无噪声电路和经典检测器具有显著更强的对抗鲁棒性，推导出每门dropout实现曲率加权L2惩罚的解析公式，并在中性原子硬件上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 先前会议研究遗留了三个开放问题：退极化通道能否替代dropout正则化、鲁棒性边界能否从保守界改进为预测性理论、以及能否扩展到真实数据集和中性原子硬件。本文旨在解决这三个问题，建立更完整的SQNN理论框架。
AI.method: 通过随机主方程和矢量化Liouvillian建立N-qubit形式化；证明退极化通道的收缩定理；在NSL-KDD数据集上对FGSM和PGD攻击进行七种子实验；推导dropout与退极化噪声的正则化效应解析公式；进行30种子统计验证；最后在中性原子硬件上实现。
AI.result: 退极化SQNN在强攻击下显著优于无噪声电路（PGD-20, p=0.04），且从不发生鲁棒性崩溃（无噪声模型从95%降至47%），鲁棒性方差降低约两倍；dropout和退极化噪声均能缩小训练-测试差距约0.01（p<10⁻⁴和p=0.004），统计上不可区分；dropout率超过1/2无效，与公式预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 退极化通道不仅是噪声，更是一种有效的防御机制；dropout在量子神经网络中实现了与经典类似的曲率加权正则化；单种子先验结果不可靠，需要多种子统计验证；中性原子硬件上的实现验证了SQNN的物理可行性。

title: Autonomous Video Generation with Counterfactual Controllability for Self-Evolving World Models
summary: Existing literature claims that video generation essentially is world modelling. On the one hand, the claim is productive because it pushes generative AI beyond static images and toward temporally extended physical scenes. On the other hand, this claim dangerously relies on the belief that scaling visual prediction alone will automatically yield physical agents. We prefer a more accurate statement: video generation models learn a partial, implicit spatiotemporal world model, but not a fully grounded or controllable one. The reason is as follows: a model may generate a plausible video of a drone crossing a forest or a robot arm manipulating a cup, yet still fail to know which variables are controllable, which constraints belong to a particular body and which futures remain valid under intervention. The frontier in essence is not predictive realism alone, instead it emphasizes a self-evolving generative nature that requires the decisive criterion to be counterfactual controllability: the capability of asking what would happen under an action, to test whether the generated future can survive embodiment constraints and to feed the resulting action knowledge back into future imagination (generation). Therefore, in this paper we present a new perspective, i.e., autonomous video generation with counterfactual controllability is one promising way to realize self-evolving world models.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了“视频生成即世界模型”的过度简化观点，提出具备反事实可控性的自主视频生成才是实现自演化世界模型的可行路径。
AI.motivation: 现有文献声称视频生成本质上是世界建模，这一主张虽推动了生成式AI从静态图像向时域物理场景发展，但危险地相信仅靠缩放视觉预测就能自动产生物理智能体。作者认为这一说法不够准确，需要更精确的定位。
AI.method: 通过理论分析论证：视频生成模型学习的是部分、隐式的时空世界模型，而非完全具身化或可控的模型。提出以反事实可控性（counterfactual controllability）作为决定性标准，即模型应能回答“在某个动作下会发生什么”，检验生成的未来能否通过具身约束，并将动作知识反馈回未来的生成过程。
AI.result: 指出现有视频生成模型即使能生成逼真的场景（如无人机穿越森林、机械臂抓取杯子），仍可能无法区分哪些变量可控、哪些约束属于特定身体、哪些未来在干预下仍然有效。预测现实主义本身并非前沿，关键在于自主生成与反事实推理的结合。
AI.conclusion: 提出新视角：具备反事实可控性的自主视频生成是通往自演化世界模型的一条有前景的路径，强调生成模型需要从被动预测转向主动干预与自我反馈的闭环。

title: Agentic AI for Bilevel Long-Term Optimization of Policy-Driven Physical Layer Systems
summary: Network operators' changing policies, service requirements, and stringent real-time constraints render existing methods designed with fixed objectives and constraints ineffective. This paper presents Agentic long-term performance optimization (Agentic-LTPO), a nested bilevel optimization framework that can be applied to adaptive physical layer problem configuration. The key idea is to employ agentic AI to generate upper-level configurations in a bilevel optimization structure, where evolving operator policies, environment summaries, and historical experiences are translated into structured lower-level optimization problem configurations. The lower level solves the problems with updated configurations for real-time physical-layer decisions. Considering cell-free MIMO beamforming as a use case, we embody Agentic-LTPO by designing a new multi-agent decision process with retrieval-augmented experience-based verification in the upper level, together with a closed-form beamformer in the lower level. Experiments demonstrate that Agentic-LTPO exhibits strong adaptability to dynamic operator policies and effectively enhances the system's long-term performance by 57.2% compared to traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic-LTPO，一种基于智能体AI的双层优化框架，用于自适应物理层问题配置。在无小区MIMO波束赋形场景中，该方法通过上层智能体生成配置、下层求解优化问题，相比传统方法提升长期性能57.2%。
AI.motivation: 网络运营商的策略变化、服务需求以及严格的实时约束，使得现有基于固定目标和约束的方法失效，亟需一种能够自适应动态环境的长期性能优化框架。
AI.method: 提出嵌套双层优化框架Agentic-LTPO：上层利用智能体AI结合检索增强经验验证生成配置，下层基于更新后的配置求解实时物理层优化问题。以无小区MIMO波束赋形为例设计多智能体决策流程与闭式波束赋形器。
AI.result: 实验表明，Agentic-LTPO对动态运营商策略展现出强适应性，相比传统方法，系统长期性能提升57.2%。
AI.conclusion: Agentic-LTPO有效解决了动态网络环境下固定目标优化方法失效的问题，通过智能体驱动的双层优化实现了网络长期性能的显著提升。

title: SURGELLM: Rethinking Multi-Task Evaluation through Task-Aware Feature Gating with Class-Balanced Normalization
comment: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), ACL 2026, San Diego, California, USA. Available at https://openreview.net/forum?id=WJCalficPT
summary: Fine-tuned encoders deployed across heterogeneous NLP tasks face three compounding problems: mismatched inductive biases, class-imbalance corruption of feature statistics, and no mechanism to condition attention on external lexical knowledge. We introduce \textbf{\surgellm}, a unified transformer framework that addresses each with a dedicated lightweight module: a \emph{surgical feature gate} (learned per-dimension sigmoid over curated lexical indicators and \texttt{[CLS]}; provably degenerates to identity when features are uninformative), \emph{task-conditioned prefix tokens} (quantized feature values and task identity prepended to every input), and \emph{Instance-Weighted Normalization} (IWN; removes class-prior bias from gate statistics). We prove an excess-risk bound linking gate benefit to \emph{surgical feature alignment}. Across four tasks, SST-2, multi-hop retrieval, LLM-prompt attribution, and authorship detection, covering 17,830 examples and eleven model variants over three seeds, the IWN variant achieves macro-F1 \textbf{0.940} ($+0.036$ over the strongest non-IWN baseline; $+0.130$ on authorship detection). A random-vocabulary control ($-0.028$ avg.\ F1) confirms gains are lexical, not parametric. Code, vocabularies, and a $99.5\%$-recovery auto-extraction recipe are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Surgelim 统一 Transformer 框架，通过三个轻量模块（手术特征门、任务条件前缀、实例加权归一化）解决微调编码器在异构 NLP 任务中面临的归纳偏差、类别不平衡和词汇注意力缺失问题。在四个任务上，IWN 变体达到 0.940 macro-F1，比最强基线提升 0.036。
AI.motivation: 微调编码器在异构 NLP 任务中存在三个叠加问题：归纳偏差不匹配、类别不平衡破坏特征统计、以及缺乏对外部词汇知识的注意力调节机制。
AI.method: 提出 Surgelim 统一 Transformer 框架，包含三个轻量模块：1）手术特征门（在词汇指示器和 [CLS] 上学习每维度 sigmoid）；2）任务条件前缀令牌（量化特征值和任务标识）；3）实例加权归一化（IWN，消除类别先验偏差）。
AI.result: 在 SST-2、多跳检索、LLM 提示归因和作者检测四个任务上，覆盖 17,830 样本和 11 种模型变体，IWN 变体达到 0.940 macro-F1（比最强非 IWN 基线高 0.036，作者检测任务高 0.130）。随机词汇对照实验（-0.028 avg. F1）证实增益来自词汇信息。
AI.conclusion: Surgelim 框架通过轻量级模块有效解决异构 NLP 任务中的多个问题，实验证明其词汇驱动的增益机制有效，代码和词汇表已开源。

title: Differential Unfolding: Efficient Unfolding Reconstruction for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging
summary: While Deep Unfolding Networks (DUNs) dominate video Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI), they remain constrained by a uniform design philosophy. Existing methods repeatedly stack high-complexity priors with identical structures, ignoring the fact that optimization trajectories converge toward static states. This results in representation stagnation, where high-cost computations are wasted on minimal feature updates. To address this inefficiency, we present Differential Unfolding (DU), a heterogeneous framework that replaces uniform repetition with dynamic evolution. Central to DU is the Differential Evolutionary Framework (DEF), which partitions the unfolding process into two complementary roles: structural anchoring and differential evolution. In this scheme, high-parameter general stages are sparsely deployed to generate high-fidelity feature foundations. Complementing these, lightweight differential stages employ a Differential Representation Prior (DRP) to propagate and refine these foundational features through a differential mechanism. By integrating Differential Representation Attention (DRA) for evolving attention maps and a Differential Modulated FFN (DM-FFN) for feature rectification, DRP effectively models cross-stage variations with minimal overhead. By focusing computational resources on dynamic evolution rather than static redundancy, DU achieves a superior trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Extensive experiments verify that our method establishes new state-of-the-art results while significantly slashing computational overhead. https://github.com/Muyuan-Zhang/DU

AI.tldr: 提出差分展开（DU）框架，通过异构设计替代传统深度展开网络的均匀重复结构，在视频快照压缩成像中实现高效动态特征演化，达到精度与效率的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有深度展开网络（DUNs）采用相同结构的高复杂度先验反复堆叠，忽略了优化轨迹趋向静态收敛的事实，导致表征停滞——大量计算浪费在微小特征更新上。为克服这一效率低下问题，需引入动态演化的异构框架。
AI.method: 提出差分展开（DU）框架，核心是差分演化框架（DEF），将展开过程分为两类互补角色：结构锚定（高参数通用阶段，稀疏部署以生成高保真特征基）和差分演化（轻量差分阶段，通过差分表示先验DRP传播和精炼特征）。DRP包含差分表示注意力DRA（演化注意力图）和差分调制FFN DM-FFN（特征修正），以极小开销建模跨阶段变化。
AI.result: 在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销，建立了新的视频SCI最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将计算资源聚焦于动态演化而非静态冗余，DU实现了优越的精度-效率权衡，验证了异构设计在深度展开网络中的有效性。

title: Can Aggregate Invariants Accelerate Continuous Subgraph Matching? Limits, Laws, and a Dynamic Spectral Index
summary: Spectral filtering recently delivered substantial pruning for \emph{static} subgraph matching: Laplacian interlacing rejects candidates whose neighborhoods cannot host the query. We study whether such aggregate structural tests can accelerate \emph{continuous} subgraph matching (CSM) over dynamic graphs, and answer in three parts. First, lazily maintained spectral bounds are infeasible exactly where spectral pruning has value: we characterize the tightest safe rule over a formalized perturbation relaxation and show that even it loses essentially all pruning power within four touching updates. Second, exact maintenance is affordable when selective: pruning utility and recomputation cost are anti-correlated across vertices -- hubs provably never prune -- so recomputing small-neighborhood spectra on touch sustains exact local spectra at microseconds per update, complete by construction. Third, integrated into a decoupled CSM benchmark against an identical-minus-spectra control, the tests remove up to $51\%$ of candidates or safely skip up to $47\%$ of update enumerations, yet enumeration intermediates remain unchanged -- beyond the gates' skipped first-level bindings, typically zero -- across two engines, four real graphs, two stream types, and $77$ solved queries; a constructed radius-stratified workload confirms the instrument detects the exception when one exists ($-99.9\%$ intermediates, $748\times$ faster). Aggregate tests accelerate what scales with candidate sets -- construction, list scans -- never adjacency-guided exploration. We distill an intermediate-invariance methodology for evaluating CSM filters and release a reusable dynamic local-spectra index.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了谱过滤技术能否加速动态图上的连续子图匹配（CSM）。结果表明：懒惰维护不可行，选择性精确维护可行且高效；集成测试可移除高达51%的候选节点或跳过47%的更新枚举，但枚举中间结果不变；聚合测试加速与候选集规模相关的阶段（构造、列表扫描），而非邻域引导的探索。
AI.motivation: 静态子图匹配中谱过滤（Laplacian interlacing）能有效剪枝，但连续子图匹配（CSM）处理动态图时，这种聚合结构测试是否也能加速尚不清楚。本文旨在系统研究该问题。
AI.method: 1) 形式化扰动松弛下的紧致安全规则分析；2) 提出选择性精确维护策略，利用剪枝效用与重计算成本的反相关性，对触碰的小邻域谱进行微秒级重计算；3) 集成到解耦的CSM基准中，与相同配置但无谱的对照组进行对比实验。
AI.result: 懒惰维护在四次更新后几乎丧失所有剪枝能力；选择性精确维护可微秒级维持精确局部谱；集成测试可移除51%候选或跳过47%更新枚举，但枚举中间结果不变；构造的半径分层负载可检测到异常情况（-99.9%中间结果，748倍加速）。
AI.conclusion: 聚合测试能加速与候选集规模相关的阶段（构造、列表扫描），但不会改变邻域引导的探索路径。提出了中间结果不变性方法论用于评估CSM过滤器，并发布了可复用的动态局部谱索引。

title: Pigeonholing: Bad prompts hurt models to collapse and make mistakes
summary: While in-context learning is generally shown to be effective in Large Language Models (LLMs), bad contexts can cause performance degradation and mode collapse, a phenomenon we call "pigeonholing." **Unintentionally bad** contexts can happen without malicious jailbreaking intents: For example, a user asks the model to justify an incorrect math theorem or fails to correct the model's buggy code. Specifically, we investigate ``pigeonholing" in two scenarios: (1) when the user suggests a solution, and (2) when the conversation context includes the assistant's previous (incorrect) responses. Our experiments across 10 verifiable and open-ended tasks with 10 different models show that pigeonholing manifests in several ways: (1) repeating the incorrect answers from context (leading to 38-40% performance drop), (2) converging on a narrow set of answers in coding and text generation without exploring alternatives, and (3) flipping stance on controversial topics to align with the user or the assistant's previous claims. We find that pigeonholing worsens almost monotonically with the number of conversation turns (performance drops by additional 14+% as repeated mistakes increase from 1 to 5), and pigeonholing-induced mode collapse can happen even when the provided example is correct. As a step toward mitigation, we propose RLVR with synthetic errors which improves models by 43-60% under bad contexts compared to vanilla RLVR baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在错误上下文（非恶意）中的"鸽笼效应"（pigeonholing），即模型会重复上下文中的错误答案、收敛于狭窄答案集或改变立场。实验发现该现象随对话轮次增加而恶化，并提出RLVR+合成错误方法可将模型性能提升43-60%。
AI.motivation: 揭示并系统研究LLMs在无意错误上下文（如用户提出错误解法或助手历史错误）下出现的性能退化与模式崩溃现象。
AI.method: 在10个可验证与开放任务上，使用10种不同模型，测试用户建议场景和助手历史错误场景；并提出RLVR结合合成错误数据的缓解方法。
AI.result: 错误上下文导致38-40%性能下降；随对话轮次增加（1→5次错误）额外下降14%以上；即使上下文示例正确也可能发生模式崩溃；RLVR+合成错误方法在错误上下文中提升43-60%。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在非恶意错误上下文中存在严重的"鸽笼效应"，需通过针对性训练方法（如RLVR+合成错误）来缓解。

title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models with Prior-Corrected Token Reduction
summary: Visual token reduction has emerged as an effective strategy for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Many existing methods prune tokens by ranking text-visual attention scores. However, we show that attention is often dominated by a model-induced prior: even without textual instruction, MLLMs tend to focus on certain task-agnostic regions. Consequently, the attention scores of instruction-conditioned tokens are suppressed, increasing the risk that these tokens are discarded during pruning. To address this issue, we propose Prior-Corrected Token Reduction (PriorTR), a training-free token reduction method that explicitly separates task-conditioned attention from the model-induced prior. PriorTR estimates the attention map of the prior, and contrasts it with the task-conditioned attention distribution to measure the additional usable information contributed by each visual token. Importantly, PriorTR computes both the model-induced prior and the task-conditioned posterior within a single forward pass by introducing a null token that serves as an instruction-agnostic probe in the attention block. This design avoids duplicated propagation. Extensive experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks and MLLMs demonstrate that PriorTR consistently improves the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency over strong training-free baselines, particularly under aggressive token budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出PriorTR方法，通过分离模型固有先验与任务条件注意力来解决视觉token剪枝中被错误丢弃的问题，在无需额外训练的情况下提升MLLMs的效率与准确率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于注意力分数的token剪枝方法中，注意力分数常被模型自身的先验主导（即使无文本指令，模型也会关注某些与任务无关的区域），导致任务相关token被错误剪枝，影响性能。
AI.method: 提出PriorTR，通过引入空token作为指令无关探针，在单次前向传播中同时估计模型先验注意力与任务条件注意力，通过对比二者衡量每个视觉token额外贡献的信息量，实现训练无关的token剪枝。
AI.result: 在多模态基准和多种MLLM上，PriorTR在准确率与效率的权衡上一致优于现有强训练无关基线，尤其在激进token预算下优势明显。
AI.conclusion: PriorTR通过显式分离模型先验与任务注意力，有效解决了注意力主导性导致的错误剪枝问题，是一种高效且无需额外训练的视觉token缩减方法。

title: ReM-MoA: Reasoning Memory Sustains Mixture-of-Agents Scaling
summary: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) architectures improve inference-time scaling by organizing multiple LLM agents into layered reasoning pipelines. However, existing MoA variants fail to sustain gains as depth increases, exhibiting degradation, early plateauing, or saturation. We propose ReM-MoA, a memory-augmented MoA framework that sustains scaling through two mechanisms: (1) a Ranked Reasoning Memory that persistently stores and ranks reasoning traces from all layers using a comparative Reviewer Agent, and (2) a Curated Diversified Memory Routing scheme that exposes different agents to distinct combinations of successful and failed traces, preserving exploration diversity while propagating high-quality reasoning. We further introduce an optional multi-domain Reviewer distillation pipeline that improves ranking quality through frontier-model supervision. Across five reasoning benchmarks spanning math, formal logic, code, knowledge, and commonsense, ReM-MoA consistently outperforms prior MoA variants across both depth and width scaling, and its advantage widens with depth, establishing structured cross-layer reasoning memory as a key missing mechanism for scalable multi-agent inference.

AI.tldr: ReM-MoA通过记忆增强机制（排序推理记忆+多样化记忆路由）解决了多智能体架构随深度扩展性能下降的问题，在多个推理基准上优于现有MoA变体。
AI.motivation: 现有MoA架构随层数增加会出现性能退化、早期停滞或饱和，无法持续获得扩展收益。
AI.method: 提出两种机制：(1) Ranked Reasoning Memory，用比较型Reviewer Agent持久存储和排序各层推理轨迹；(2) Curated Diversified Memory Routing，让不同智能体接触成功/失败轨迹的不同组合，保持探索多样性。可选的多领域Reviewer蒸馏提升排序质量。
AI.result: 在数学、形式逻辑、代码、知识和常识五个推理基准上，ReM-MoA在深度和宽度扩展上均持续优于现有MoA变体，且优势随深度增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的跨层推理记忆是实现可扩展多智能体推理的关键机制。

title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
summary: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering.
